title: Delivery Consultant - Product Development & Procurement
description:
Who You'll Work With
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
• Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
• A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
• Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
• World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
Your Impact
You will spend about 80% of your time working at a client location as part of a consulting team, helping to solve complex problems in the domains of product development and procurement.
This work includes, but is not limited to: end-to-end margin transformation, product- and organization-level EBITDA improvement, rationalizing product design based on competitive teardown analysis and customer insights and building and implementing sourcing strategies.
You will also help client teams estimate product should-costs using clean sheet costing, enabling the design of low-cost products. Your work may extend to new product development, where you will focus on reducing development time, cost, and improving quality attributes. You may also conduct surveys to identify improvement areas within organizations to support effective and efficient product development, ultimately helping clients build sustainable R&D capabilities. Other focus areas may include design-to-cost, design-to-value, global sourcing, commodity strategy, cost structure optimization, clean-sheet costing, supplier development, negotiation, strategic sourcing, cost-saving idea identification and leverage, cost reduction, spend analysis, and procurement transformation.
Our Product Development & Procurement (PDP) service line helps organizations transform how they design, develop, source, and deliver products and services. By combining customer insights, advanced analytics, engineering excellence, and procurement expertise, we enable clients to accelerate innovation, unlock sustainable value, and create lasting competitive advantage.
You will work directly with client leaders and front-line operators on topics where implementation issues are important and where driving changes are critical to successful realization of organizational goals. You will be staffed to projects or engagements, working closely with clients. You will work closely and in partnership with clients' senior management and their specialist departments.
You will be based in one of our India offices - Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Kolkata or Mumbai - as a part of Delivery Assurance Path in the Operations practice.
Delivery Assurance (DA) focuses on value creation - turning strategy into execution. Our work demands a dual toolkit: deep delivery and process expertise, combined with the content and problem-solving strength of McKinsey consultants. This blend makes DA work unique, demanding, and has a high impact. You will be a part of a rapidly scaling global community of 700+ DA consultants, with presence across all regions of the globe and hubs in 34 countries (and counting). We service clients across the public and private sector and industries.
Our Operations practice sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation to deliver sustainable and inclusive growth. It assists our clients in solving complex operational challenges.
Your Qualifications and Skills
• A bachelor’s degree is required, with preference in engineering domain
• 2+ years of experience in product development and design or product cost optimization or strategic sourcing/purchasing or supplier development or spend analysis or commodity strategy, or cost reduction, negotiations, etc.; preferred industries: automotive.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to independently structure and design the solution 
• Strong desire to learn and develop within a dynamic, self-led organization
• Open to extensive travel to client sites. 
• Ability to work under pressure and deliver to tight deadlines.
• Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization and to collaborate within a team
• Language fluency skills & ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, in English

You will identify opportunities for operational improvement, redesign care workflows, and support the development of strategies, transformation initiatives, and implementation of roadmaps that enhance healthcare delivery and organizational performance.
Your work also involves translating complex medical policies and clinical guidelines for business stakeholders and having the ability to further translate these policies into analytical frameworks that inform decision making. Drawing on these insights, you will identify gaps in care, clinical risks, and opportunities for improvement while designing ideal care journeys across a range of disease areas, including chronic conditions such as diabetes and chronic kidney disease (CKD). This includes defining key interventions, milestones, and care pathways across different stages of disease progression, identifying clinical markers that signal emerging risks or worsening conditions, and leveraging analytics to identify at-risk populations and recommend targeted actions that improve health outcomes and care effectiveness.
Working closely with clients, McKinsey teams, and practice leaders, you will build tenure-appropriate client relationships, facilitate syndication and problem-solving discussions, and support implementation efforts. You will contribute to workshops, client events, and frontline transformations, applying strong project management and communication skills to help translate recommendations into tangible results.
You will join our Client Capabilities Network in the Gurugram office as part of the Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes (HALO) domain within the Social, Healthcare and Public Entities (SHaPE) practice.
HALO brings together clinicians, healthcare experts, consultants, data scientists, and engineers to help healthcare organizations improve affordability, access, quality, and operational effectiveness. The team develops and deploys proprietary analytics, expertise, and transformation capabilities to support payors, healthcare services organizations, provider-led health plans, and other risk-bearing healthcare entities. Together, we aspire to improve healthcare performance and outcomes at scale.
Beyond client engagements, you will contribute to the development of new knowledge, intellectual property, and capabilities that strengthen HALO's healthcare offerings and extend our impact across clients globally.
Your Qualifications and Skills
• Medical degree, such as MBBS or related qualification, preferred
• 2+ years of experience in healthcare transformation, healthcare operations, payer or provider organizations, clinical operations, healthcare strategy, or management consulting
• Strong understanding of healthcare delivery models, clinical workflows, healthcare operations, and performance improvement methodologies, with the ability to connect clinical knowledge to operational and business outcomes
• Familiarity with SQL and experience querying data from relational databases or cloud-based data environments
• Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a team-based, entrepreneurial environment
• Experience facilitating workshops, developing implementation roadmaps, and supporting organizational change initiatives is preferred
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical, operational, and analytical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for diverse stakeholders

At EY, our objective is to help clients improve the performance and productivity of their Supply Chain & Operations (SC&O). With expertise in leading Enterprise Asset Management frameworks, you will help clients to effectively manage both the physical and non-physical assets through the entire lifecycle, maximising performance and productivity whilst reducing the total cost of operations / ownership.
The client base spans across industries and includes multinational companies in oil & gas, power & utilities, government, banking, consumer goods & retail, manufacturing etc.
The opportunity
We are looking for a passionate Senior Consultant with expertise in Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) to join the group within our Business Consulting sub-service line and work with clients and project teams in EAM engagements. The role focuses on asset centric transformation covering governance, lifecycle strategy, performance optimization, and digital enablement—helping clients maximize asset value, optimize TOTEX, improve reliability, and strengthen decision-making across the asset lifecycle.
Your Key Responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant, you will be part of a team of professionals with extensive consulting and industry experience. Drawing on your knowledge and experience, you will create innovative insights for clients, bringing software / digital solutions and strategies to optimise their asset management capabilities and sustain performance improvement. As an influential member of the team, you will help create a positive learning culture; coach, counsel, and nurture junior team members.
An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships. Travel may be required based on business/client requirement.
Typically, you will work across below EAM service offerings:
Governance and Assurance
• Design Asset Governance frameworks and Target Operating Models aligned to business strategy and regulatory requirements
• Conduct ISO 55001 alignment assessments and EAM maturity diagnostics
• Develop risk, control, and performance assurance frameworks across asset lifecycle processes
• Integrate ESG considerations into asset strategies, governance models, and performance reporting
Lifecycle Strategy & TOTEX Optimization
• Develop Strategic Asset Management Plans (SAMPs) and asset class level AM plans
• Design and document EAM processes, policies, and procedures across the end to end asset lifecycle
• Support asset investment planning, prioritization, and portfolio optimization
• Define value frameworks and TOTEX optimization approaches linking Capex, Opex, risk, and performance
• Support asset decommissioning strategies and transition planning
Asset Performance & Reliability
• Deliver asset performance optimization and reliability improvement initiatives
• Design and improve maintenance management and reliability engineering frameworks
• Support work management transformation, including planning, scheduling, and execution optimization
• Optimize asset spares and inventory strategies to balance availability, cost, and risk
Asset Intelligence & Decision Enablement
• Define asset data and information management strategies, including data governance and quality
• Develop decision support frameworks and AI readiness roadmaps for EAM and asset￼intensive operations
• Support selection, assessment, and optimization of EAM systems (e.g., SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle)
• Drive IoT and sensorization use cases for condition monitoring and predictive insights
• Support implementation of digital twins and BIM enabled asset management solutions
Your consulting and delivery responsibilities will be including and not limited to below:
• Work closely with MENA clients to translate business and asset management challenges into practical, scalable EAM solutions
• Lead and contribute to client workshops, diagnostics, and design sessions
• Deliver high‑quality consulting outputs aligned to EY quality and delivery standards
• Support business development and proposal efforts aligned to established EAM offerings
• Coach junior team members and contribute to capability building within the EAM practice
Skills And Attributes For Success
• Strong EAM domain knowledge across governance, lifecycle management, maintenance, and performance
• Experience working across asset intensive industries (Oil & Gas, Utilities, Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Cities and Municipalities, Facility Management, etc.)
• Understanding of ISO 55001, ESG, and risk based asset management concepts
• Exposure to AI, analytics, IoT, digital twins, and emerging asset technologies
• Structured problem solving, client facing communication, and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to translate strategy into operable processes, frameworks, and systems

• Consulting experience in asset performance improvement, governance, cost optimization, or process design
• Exposure to EAM systems (SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle, Asset investment planning tool, etc.)
• Experience developing process documentation, frameworks, and maturity assessments
• Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain Management
• Willingness to travel onsite for client assignments, if required
• Willingness to work Sunday to Thursday and support MENA region’s client timings 
Ideally, you should also have
• Project management skills
• Customer handling, Report writing, Strong interpersonal communication skills, and experience in usage of analytical tools/ representations
• Certification / working knowledge in ISO 55001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001
• Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, KAIZEN, CAMA 2, IAM Diploma and IAM certificate as an added/preferred advantage
What We Offer
• A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
• An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of business consultant professionals, in the integrated global business worldwide.
• Opportunities to work with EY Business Consulting practices regionally/globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What Working At EY Offers
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
• The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
EY | Building a better working world 
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: EY Business Consulting - Supply Chain Domain - Enterprise Asset Management - Senior Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY Business Consulting – Supply Chain Domain - Enterprise Asset Management - Senior Consultant 
At EY, our objective is to help clients improve the performance and productivity of their Supply Chain & Operations (SC&O). With expertise in leading Enterprise Asset Management frameworks, you will help clients to effectively manage both the physical and non-physical assets through the entire lifecycle, maximising performance and productivity whilst reducing the total cost of operations / ownership.
The client base spans across industries and includes multinational companies in oil & gas, power & utilities, government, banking, consumer goods & retail, manufacturing etc.
The opportunity
We are looking for a passionate Senior Consultant with expertise in Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) to join the group within our Business Consulting sub-service line and work with clients and project teams in EAM engagements. The role focuses on asset centric transformation covering governance, lifecycle strategy, performance optimization, and digital enablement—helping clients maximize asset value, optimize TOTEX, improve reliability, and strengthen decision-making across the asset lifecycle.
Your Key Responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant, you will be part of a team of professionals with extensive consulting and industry experience. Drawing on your knowledge and experience, you will create innovative insights for clients, bringing software / digital solutions and strategies to optimise their asset management capabilities and sustain performance improvement. As an influential member of the team, you will help create a positive learning culture; coach, counsel, and nurture junior team members.
An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships. Travel may be required based on business/client requirement.
Typically, you will work across below EAM service offerings:
Governance and Assurance
• Design Asset Governance frameworks and Target Operating Models aligned to business strategy and regulatory requirements
• Conduct ISO 55001 alignment assessments and EAM maturity diagnostics
• Develop risk, control, and performance assurance frameworks across asset lifecycle processes
• Integrate ESG considerations into asset strategies, governance models, and performance reporting
Lifecycle Strategy & TOTEX Optimization
• Develop Strategic Asset Management Plans (SAMPs) and asset class level AM plans
• Design and document EAM processes, policies, and procedures across the end to end asset lifecycle
• Support asset investment planning, prioritization, and portfolio optimization
• Define value frameworks and TOTEX optimization approaches linking Capex, Opex, risk, and performance
• Support asset decommissioning strategies and transition planning
Asset Performance & Reliability
• Deliver asset performance optimization and reliability improvement initiatives
• Design and improve maintenance management and reliability engineering frameworks
• Support work management transformation, including planning, scheduling, and execution optimization
• Optimize asset spares and inventory strategies to balance availability, cost, and risk
Asset Intelligence & Decision Enablement
• Define asset data and information management strategies, including data governance and quality
• Develop decision support frameworks and AI readiness roadmaps for EAM and asset￼intensive operations
• Support selection, assessment, and optimization of EAM systems (e.g., SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle)
• Drive IoT and sensorization use cases for condition monitoring and predictive insights
• Support implementation of digital twins and BIM enabled asset management solutions
Your consulting and delivery responsibilities will be including and not limited to below:
• Work closely with MENA clients to translate business and asset management challenges into practical, scalable EAM solutions
• Lead and contribute to client workshops, diagnostics, and design sessions
• Deliver high‑quality consulting outputs aligned to EY quality and delivery standards
• Support business development and proposal efforts aligned to established EAM offerings
• Coach junior team members and contribute to capability building within the EAM practice
Skills And Attributes For Success
• Strong EAM domain knowledge across governance, lifecycle management, maintenance, and performance
• Experience working across asset intensive industries (Oil & Gas, Utilities, Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Cities and Municipalities, Facility Management, etc.)
• Understanding of ISO 55001, ESG, and risk based asset management concepts
• Exposure to AI, analytics, IoT, digital twins, and emerging asset technologies
• Structured problem solving, client facing communication, and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to translate strategy into operable processes, frameworks, and systems
To qualify for the role, you must have
• 4–8 years of experience in Enterprise Asset Management, Asset intensive Operations, or related consulting roles
• Consulting experience in asset performance improvement, governance, cost optimization, or process design
• Exposure to EAM systems (SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle, Asset investment planning tool, etc.)
• Experience developing process documentation, frameworks, and maturity assessments
• Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain Management
• Willingness to travel onsite for client assignments, if required
• Willingness to work Sunday to Thursday and support MENA region’s client timings 
Ideally, you should also have
• Project management skills
• Customer handling, Report writing, Strong interpersonal communication skills, and experience in usage of analytical tools/ representations
• Certification / working knowledge in ISO 55001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001
• Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, KAIZEN, CAMA 2, IAM Diploma and IAM certificate as an added/preferred advantage
What We Offer
• A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
• An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of business consultant professionals, in the integrated global business worldwide.
• Opportunities to work with EY Business Consulting practices regionally/globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What Working At EY Offers
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
• The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
EY | Building a better working world 
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools
• Solid understanding of e-commerce algorithms, PDP optimization, bidding strategies, and digital shelf management
• Excellent client and stakeholder management skills with prior CXO-level exposure

description:
Overview
Microsoft Industry Solutions - Global Center for Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 2000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles. The ideal consultant is passionate about technology, has breadth rather than specific product depth, and has the drive and courage to articulate and stand up for a great solution delivering true value for the client.  
As a Data & AI consultant, you will deliver quality engagements with your expertise, as a key contributor to high profile data and AI projects to ensure customer value. The ideal candidate must have the ability to combine their technical skills, leadership skills, creativity, and customer focus to deliver great solutions to the customers and ensure they get the best out of our technologies and solutions. Consulting Delivery professionals bring subject matter and solution expertise to architectural teams, customers, and partners. They apply deep technical and business knowledge to accelerate the adoption of Microsoft devices and services by ensuring strategic, architectural, and operational alignment to customer and partner objectives. 
Responsibilities
• Works as an Individual contributor and key member of the Data and AI team and helps in timely execution of assigned deliverables with accurate estimates, work priorities, and accommodates project changes and trade-offs necessary for a successful release.    
• Applies technical experience and industry-specific knowledge to develop solutions, based on an analysis of how the proposed approach affects the business objectives of customers and partners.   
• Works to accelerate the value proposition of customer/partner engagements by helping to design, develop, and deploy solutions on Microsoft technologies and methodologies.   
• Contributes to the overall efficacy and quality of a project team’s technical delivery within assigned engagements.   
• Defines dependencies and risks that go beyond the immediate scope and timeframe for a complex project. Develops contingency plans, risk-mitigation implementation criteria, and alternative strategies to manage short- and long-term risks and manages technical escalations.   
• Drives opportunities to expand or accelerate the adoption and consumption of cloud and Microsoft technologies. Collaborates, as appropriate, with peers and other teams (e.g., Sales, account-aligned team) to scale the business with existing high-stake or strategic customers, by articulating/developing value propositions of strategic Microsoft products and services.    
• Align with innovation and digital transformation initiatives. Ensures the use of existing intellectual property (IP) and delivers value to customers.   
• Responsible for implementing the technology strategy with support from Senior peers  
• Applies information-compliance and assurance policies to ensure stakeholder confidence.   
• Drives new ways of thinking, across the division and subsidiary, to improve quality, engineering productivity, and responsiveness to feedback and changing priorities.  
• Consistently upskills through regular trainings and certifications on Azure Data and AI to be able to contribute to the future needs of the organization and customers  
Qualifications
• 4 - 6 years of experience   
• Bachelor's degree in computer science engineering or equivalent work experience. Higher relevant education is preferred.   
• Knowledge of solution design, planning, development and deployment of complex solutions 
• One or more of the following certifications, or an equivalent industry certification is a plus:   Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-600)  / Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI102)  / Microsoft Certified: Azure Solution Architect Expert (AZ-305)   
Core Data Engineering & Platform Skills
• Hands-on experience in Data Engineering across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments 
• Strong foundational experience with Azure Data Services and data platform modernization initiatives 
• Handson exposure to Data Warehouse and analytics using platforms like Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Synapse Analytics; Azure Databricks is a plus 
• Experience/knowledge of one or more SQL and NoSQL database systems 
• Hands-on experience building AI-powered data pipelines using ETL/ELT tools like: 
• Azure Data Factory (ADF), SSIS, Talend, Informatica, Airflow 
• Exposure to data migrations, platform upgrades, and modernization efforts 
• Understanding of multitenant data platform designs, basic security hardening, and access control concepts 
• Knowledge of Big Data ecosystems like Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Hadoop, etc. 
AI / ML Foundations
• Experience building or supporting ML ready datasets and basic feature engineering 
• Exposure to operationalizing ML pipelines and MLOps concepts, on Azure stack 
• Foundational knowledge of: 
• Large Language Models (LLMs) 
• Model training, evaluation, and deployment workflows 
• Azure cloud and AI stack like Azure Foundry, Azure OpenAI, etc 
• Handson experience or knowledge in one or more of: 
• NLP, Document Intelligence & Indexing 
• Computer Vision 
• RAG frameworks or AI Search 
• Basic understanding of Prompt Engineering 
• Exposure to or knowledge of deep learning/Gen AI frameworks such as TensorFlow/PyTorch, and orchestration frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph

title: Manager- BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
What You'll Do
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's India PIPE Practice Area, you will work in a growing team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized BCG Vantage assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain-specific data and related expertise, etc.). You will contribute to cases through thought partnership in your area of expertise, deliver original analyses and insights helping drive strong impact with clients. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, travel to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments is expected to understand client requirements, and design / develop solutions.
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, providing insights & advice for proposals and client workshops. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you may lead development of intellectual property & assets for the business and mentor and guide junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise.
BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area is one of the firm's largest and fastest-growing practices, working with the world's leading investment firms across the full deal and value-creation lifecycle — from thesis generation and commercial due diligence through 100-day planning, hold-period value creation, and exit readiness.
To succeed in this environment, our teams blend deep investor perspective with digital and human capabilities, bringing rigorous diligence discipline, portfolio operating expertise, and proprietary data and tools to every engagement. You will support commercialization efforts across PIPE topics and asset classes — contributing diligence-ready analysis, benchmarking, and insights to proposals, investment committee materials, client workshops, and marketing content
What You'll Bring
•  3+ years consulting experience in relevant PIPE required, candidates with private equity, investment banking, or transaction advisory consulting experience preferred
•  In lieu of consulting experience, 4+ years minimum industry experience required (e.g., private equity, investment banking, corporate development, portfolio operations); 5-8+ years of relevant industry experience strongly preferred
•  Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree, e.g., MBA or CFA, preferred)
•  Fluency in English; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
•  Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholders — including deal teams, investor clients, and portfolio company executives — while working in a collaborative team environment
•  Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g., APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the diligence and analytics landscape evolves
•  Familiarity with investor workflows and terminology (e.g., LOIs, IC memos, LBO mechanics, value creation plans, GP/LP reporting) a strong plus
•  Strong problem solving skills
Who You'll Work With
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants in India, for India. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
Additional info
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)
•  Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets
Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)
•  Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients
Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)
•  Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data
YOU'RE GOOD AT
•  Solving complex investor and portfolio-company problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions across one or more PIPE topic areas or asset classes (e.g., commercial due diligence, value creation, exit readiness, private credit, infrastructure investing)
•  Engaging senior stakeholders and client team members, delivering targeted communication based on stakeholder settings - deal partners, portfolio operating executives, and investor clients — demonstrating the ability to engage a sophisticated, deal-focused audience effectively
•  Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance diligence quality, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable and knowledge frameworks tailored to investor workflows
•  Managing projects with ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating business sense and adaptability
•  Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
•  Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Consultant - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development
• Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. 
• Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. 
• Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. 
• Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. 
Client Engagement & Advisory Support
• Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. 
• Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. 
• Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. 
• Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. 
Data & AI Foundations
• Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. 
• Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. 
• Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. 
• Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Business Strategy & Operations -Senior Associate-Bangalore
description:

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagements while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. Responsibilities
•  Collaborating with senior client stakeholders to co-design and deliver tailored interventions

•  Engaging in multidisciplinary collaboration to stimulate innovation and unlock data possibilities

What You Must Have

title: Senior Analyst - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
What You'll Do
As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's Social Impact Practice Area, you will work in a growing global team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized BCG Vantage assets in areas such as K-12 education (Subtopics such as ECCE, AI x Education, Assessment to action, Exemplar schools, School to Work transition, secondary reforms etc.) higher education (greenfield set-up and brownfield transformation) and Skilling (ITI transformation, Short term skilling etc). You will contribute on cases and proposals by contributing relevant analysis and insights and help case teams create strong impact for the client. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, travel to serve clients onsite is expected to deliver impact.
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage, you will contribute to developing intellectual property & assets for the business and assist in onboarding and training junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise.
BCG is a leader in Social Impact – it is core to our firm and part of our values. We are working with social, public, and private sector organizations, driving positive impact for society. We work across the value chain of the education sector and have delivered several projects in school education, higher education, and skilling. Our education practice experts have extensive experience working on large-scale education transformation projects with state governments and Ministries in India. Overall, BCG, globally, has undertaken over 500+ projects in the education sector – across both private and government sectors.
What You'll Bring
•  4-6 years of industry experience in Education & Skilling sectors; candidates with consulting experience strongly preferred
•  Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
•  Demonstrated expertise in Education & skilling (K-12, Higher Education, TVET etc.) preferably with experience of working with governments (policy, implementation and multi-year transformation programs) and/or Donor funded (e.g., ADB, World Bank) programs
•  Excellent written and verbal communication (English at proficiency level required)
•  Fluent in using AI tools, curiosity/openness to experiment with AI tools to deliver higher value for clients
•  Ability to manage complex stakeholder discussions and work in a fast-paced environment with quick turnaround time
•  Ability to get work done in challenging environment by demonstrating growth mindset and learning adaptability
Who You'll Work With
As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
Additional info
YOU'RE GOOD AT
•  Managing and delivering value for clients
• Operating comfortably in a client-facing role, managing demanding internal and external clients in a positive, service-oriented way
• Building strong relationships and demonstrating adaptability to bring value to teams at all stages of business development and case work
• Communicating with senior client stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to engage your audience effectively
•  Applying deep topic/sector expertise to client context
• Applying deep education and skilling expertise on designing high impact solutions for the client keeping in mind what is desirable, feasible and viable on ground
• Delivering high quality, client ready deliverables incl. memo, presentations, documents with structured, clear and visually engaging content adapted to client context and needs
• Driving development of knowledge assets e.g. tools, databases, case vignettes, proposal repositories etc. and supporting business development efforts
•  Leading self and operating in agile environment
• Demonstrating strong ownership to generate high quality work in an entrepreneurial way
• Prioritizing workload including through transparent discussion with senior stakeholders, operating with autonomy to execute on the planned priorities
• Working flexibly, in an ever changing and complex environment, bringing a curious and creative mindset, demonstrating an openness and drive for purposing new and innovative ideas, and being comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here  for more information on E-Verify.

title: I&P GN - Song – Marketing- Consultant - Process Excellence-PE
description:
I&P - MT - Marketing Process Excellence - Consultant
Management Level
9 / Consultant
Must Have Skills
Marketing Process Redesign, Marketing Operating Model Transformation, AI & Automation Integration, Client Consulting
Good To Have Skills
Agent Experience (AX) Design, Process Mapping/Mining, MarTech and AdTech Ecosystems, Data Visualization (Tableau/Power BI)
Job Summary
Practice: I&P | Global Network - SONG | Areas of Work: Marketing Process Excellence, AI-Enabled Marketing Transformation, Future-State Marketing Process Design, Marketing Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.
As a Consultant, you will help clients reimagine how marketing work gets done across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, content, media, CRM, social, search, and measurement through process redesign, digital innovation, data-driven decision-making, and AI-powered ways of working. Operating at the intersection of customer experience, marketing, analytics, technology, and operations, you will lead workstreams, conduct capability and process assessments, define future-state processes and operating models, shape transformation roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes that improve growth, customer value, and operational effectiveness.
 You Are
You are a hands-on marketing transformation leader who can take ownership of a client workstream from diagnostic through future-state design. You combine practical knowledge of how modern marketing functions operate with structured process excellence methods, and you can translate business priorities into clear process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, and adoption requirements.
You design at the intersection of marketer, AI agent, platform, and process. You apply Agent Experience (AX) Design principles to determine where AI agents can support or automate work, where human judgment is essential, and how roles, controls, escalation, and handoffs should be designed to improve speed, quality, compliance, and business outcomes.
Roles & Responsibilities
Use AI tools across research, analysis, design, and deliverable creation, and identify opportunities to embed AI and agentic solutions into redesigned marketing processes. As a Consultant, you will be expected to independently lead workstreams, facilitate client discussions, and convert analysis into implementation-ready recommendations. Your responsibilities include:
Marketing Transformation & Benchmarking
• Assess marketing trends, customer and channel shifts, and peer practices to identify process reinvention opportunities across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, campaign planning, content operations, media, CRM/lifecycle marketing, social and influencer marketing, search, marketing operations, and measurement.
• Lead capability and process diagnostics and benchmarking to identify performance gaps, pain points, control issues, duplication, and opportunities to improve productivity, speed-to-market, customer experience, marketing effectiveness, and cost efficiency.
• Build data-driven assessments and executive-ready insights using AI-assisted analysis and visualization tools, translating findings into clear transformation priorities.
Future-State Marketing Process Design
• Lead future-state marketing process and operating model design covering AI integration points, workflow automation, decision rights, governance, human-machine interaction, platform enablement, measurement, and workforce adoption.
• Lead client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; facilitate co-creation across marketing, content, media, CRM, analytics, technology, and operations teams; and present recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
• Connect future-state marketing processes to MarTech/AdTech platforms and delivery realities so that transformation designs are practical, scalable, measurable, and ready for implementation.
Operating Model, Change & Adoption
• Develop change-impact assessments covering roles, skills, governance, ways of working, service delivery, and adoption implications created by redesigned marketing processes.
• Build and maintain marketing process playbooks, redesign methods, benchmarks, and reusable assets; contribute to proposals and thought leadership; and coach junior practitioners on marketing process excellence and operating model design.
AI & AX Design Application
• Embed Agent Experience (AX) Design principles into marketing process specifications by defining AI agent roles, autonomy levels, decision boundaries, controls, escalation triggers, and human-agent handoffs within redesigned workflows.
• Identify practical agentic use cases across marketing planning, insight generation, content and campaign operations, optimization, measurement, and reporting, with appropriate controls and governance.
Professional & Technical Skills
• 2-8 years of experience in process excellence, marketing transformation, functional consulting, or management consulting, with increasing independence across engagements.
• Demonstrated ability to lead client workstreams, conduct capability and current-state process assessments, facilitate workshops, and present future-state recommendations to senior stakeholders.
• Strong understanding of marketing operating models and processes across two or more areas such as campaign management, content operations, media, CRM, social and influencer marketing, search, MarTech, or measurement.
• Working knowledge of how AI, automation, and agentic solutions can be integrated into marketing processes, including operating model and governance implications.
• Experience with process mapping, benchmarking, change-impact analysis, and business case development; ability to translate data into structured, business-ready recommendations.
• Strong communication, workshop facilitation, and client relationship skills, with the ability to explain complex process, AI, data, and technology choices in business terms.
• Ability to connect customer and growth outcomes with marketing process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, measurement, and adoption requirements.
• Experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments and managing multiple workstreams with client-facing accountability.
• Experience contributing to business development, proposal/RFP development, reusable assets, or thought leadership, and coaching junior practitioners, is preferred.
Additional Information
• Experience in consumer-led B2C industries is strongly preferred, including Consumer Goods & Services, Retail, Life Sciences, Automotive, Travel, Communications & Media, or similar sectors with scaled marketing operations.
• Familiarity with process mapping or process mining tools such as Visio, Signavio, ARIS, or equivalent is a strong differentiator.
• Exposure to MarTech/AdTech ecosystems such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce, Sprinklr, Google Marketing Platform, or comparable enterprise platforms is desirable.
• Applied knowledge of Agent Experience (AX) Design principles - including agent autonomy, handoffs, escalation, controls, and human oversight - is preferred.
• Strong analytical skills and ability to connect process improvements to measurable marketing outcomes such as productivity, speed-to-market, engagement, conversion, ROI, or customer experience.
• Proactive approach to continuous learning; stays current on AI, agentic marketing, automation, marketing operating models, and emerging digital marketing practices.
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world's largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 774,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives.

title: I&P GN - Song – Service- Consultant - Process Excellence-PE
description:
Job Title – Service Operating Model & Process Design – Consultant – I&P GN
Management Level : 09 - Consultant
Location: Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Pune/ Hyderabad/ Chennai
Must have skills: Process Excellence, Process Re-engineering, Customer Service Transformation, Lean Six Sigma
Good to have skills: Customer Experience Design, AI-enabled Process Design, Process Mining, CCaaS, CRM, Operating Model Design
Job Summary: 
As a Service Operating Model & Process Design Team Lead/Consultant, you will support process and service transformation engagements, from assessing market, customer, and technology shifts through defining future-state process and service strategies and enabling adoption. You will combine process re-engineering and Lean Six Sigma rigor with customer experience design to diagnose service friction, quantify its impact, and design practical future-state processes, operating models, technology enablement, and AI integration. You will produce structured analytical work and supporting materials that enable senior practitioners to shape transformation recommendations.
Roles & Responsibilities: 
•  Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for the assigned domain.
•  Map and model current-state and future-state service processes using structured notation and modelling tools; document handoffs, decision points, and channel transitions across the customer journey.
•  Apply Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value stream mapping, and root cause analysis, to identify service-process inefficiencies and quantify improvement opportunities.
•  Develop customer journey maps and service blueprints that identify key touchpoints, friction points, and opportunities to improve experience and efficiency.
•  Conduct process analysis and support the delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations, including contact centre and customer service technology.
•  Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools; connect process metrics to customer outcomes such as first contact resolution, handling time, containment, and satisfaction.
•  Conduct benchmarking analysis using AI-accelerated industry and peer-comparison tools.
•  Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.
•  Use relevant AI tools across tasks and deliverable creation, including creating agents and other tools that support analysis and delivery.
•  Apply industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.
Professional & Technical Skills: 
Basic Qualification:
•  Proficiency in process modelling tools and software such as Visio, ARIS, or Signavio.
•  Experience with process mining and data analytics tools such as Celonis or Power Automate.
•  Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into business-process and customer-service design.
•  Exposure to customer service or contact centre operations, including familiarity with core service metrics.
•  Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project-management skills.
•  Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations for senior review.
Preferred Qualification:
•  Experience in a management consulting firm.
•  Exposure to CRM or contact centre platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, or Amazon Connect.
•  Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms.
•  Experience working on proposals and contributing to business-development activities.
•  Lean Six Sigma certification, with Green Belt or above preferred.
Additional Information: 
•  The ideal candidate combines process-analysis capability, customer-centric service design, AI-enabled transformation, and the ability to develop structured recommendations.
•  The role requires growing fluency in process disciplines and the ability to design interactions among people, AI agents, and processes across the service journey.
About Our Company | Accenture

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Consultant - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development
• Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. 
• Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. 
• Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. 
• Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. 
Client Engagement & Advisory Support
• Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. 
• Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. 
• Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. 
• Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. 
Data & AI Foundations
• Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. 
• Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. 
• Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. 
• Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: PLA Principal, Enterprise Solutions
description:
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
ERP: Finance Focus (FICO)
About The Role
As a Lead ERP – Finance Specialist, you will lead finance transformation programs leveraging ERP solutions such as SAP S/4HANA FICO, Treasury, and Financial Planning & Budgeting. You will collaborate with client CFOs, finance leaders, and BCG partners to deliver end-to-end ERP-enabled finance modernization initiatives.
What You’ll Do
• Lead finance-focused ERP transformations across General Ledger, AP/AR, Asset Accounting, and Treasury Management.
• Drive integration between Controlling (CO), Project Systems (PS), and Planning & Budgeting.
• Provide strategic guidance on finance data models, cost allocations, and statutory reporting.
• Design future-state processes for financial close, consolidation, and performance management.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks (IFRS, GAAP) and internal controls.
• Work closely with clients to optimize Capex/Opex through ERP and digital finance initiatives.
What You’ll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)
• 16+ years in ERP finance roles with deep SAP FICO, Treasury, or BPC/Group Reporting experience.
• Experience designing and deploying end-to-end finance solutions in S/4HANA or equivalent ERP.
• Exposure to projects integrating finance with supply chain, procurement, and HR.
• Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and project accounting.
• Experience engaging with CFOs, Controllers, and Finance Transformation leaders.
ERP – Sales and Distribution Focus (SD)
About The Role
As a Lead ERP – Sales Specialist, you will lead end-to-end design and delivery of ERP sales, order management, and pricing processes using SAP SD, AATP, and CRM/BRIM capabilities.
What You’ll Do
• Lead ERP transformations across Order-to-Cash (O2C), Billing, and Pricing processes.
• Implement and optimize SAP SD, AATP, and integrated CRM/BRIM platforms.
• Enable digital customer experience and omnichannel sales models within ERP.
• Develop revenue recognition and subscription-based pricing capabilities.
• Collaborate with marketing and supply chain functions for integrated sales operations.
What You’ll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)
• 16+ years’ experience in ERP-led sales and customer operations transformation.
• Deep SAP SD and CRM/BRIM expertise; AATP experience preferred.
• Strong grasp of order fulfillment, returns, rebate, and pricing management processes.
• Exposure to industries like CPG, manufacturing, or telecom.
• Experience engaging with Sales, Commercial, and Digital Transformation leaders.
ERP – Procurement and Supply Chain Focus
About The Role
As a Lead ERP – Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist, you will design and implement ERP-driven procurement and sourcing processes that deliver efficiency, transparency, and savings. You will lead initiatives using SAP MM, WM, and complementary tools like Ariba, Coupa, and iValua.
What You’ll Do
• Lead ERP transformations in Procurement, Vendor Management, and Warehouse Operations.
• Architect and integrate eProcurement and Source-to-Pay platforms (Ariba, Coupa, iValua) with ERP.
• Optimize inventory and warehouse operations through SAP MM and WM modules.
• Enhance supplier collaboration through catalogs, SRM, and spend analytics.
• Develop KPIs for procurement effectiveness, compliance, and sustainability goals.
What You’ll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)
• 16+ years’ experience in ERP procurement and logistics, with deep SAP MM and WM expertise.
• Working knowledge of QM, SRM, Ariba, Coupa, or iValua integration with ERP.
• Strong understanding of supply base rationalization, contract lifecycle, and cost optimization.
• Experience advising CPOs and Procurement Transformation teams.
• Exposure to AI/analytics-driven procurement insights preferred.
About BCG Platinion
BCG Platinion is part of the Boston Consulting Group (BCG) family, specializing in technology consulting that bridges strategic business challenges with modern technology solutions. BCG Platinion is a rapidly growing global team of leading tech experts. We are shaping the future of technology consulting by combining business expertise with cutting-edge technology capabilities. We help our clients solve their most pressing challenges by designing and delivering enterprise architecture solutions. We partner with clients across industries to design and implement enterprise architecture and digital transformation programs that drive innovation, agility, and scalable value.
Why Join BCG Platinion
At BCG Platinion, You Will Enjoy:
• A challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting
• A diverse and inclusive culture that values your unique perspective and contribution
• Enterprise Architecture consulting with implementation and value realization in a client setting
• A supportive and collaborative environment that fosters your personal growth and development
• A competitive compensation and benefits package that reflects your skills and experience
• Opportunity to deepen knowledge in specific industries and gain implementation experience.
If you want a challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting, apply now!

title: I&P GN - Song – Marketing- Consultant - Process Excellence-PE
description:
I&P - MT - Marketing Process Excellence - Consultant
Management Level
9 / Consultant
Must Have Skills
Marketing Process Redesign, Marketing Operating Model Transformation, AI & Automation Integration, Client Consulting
Good To Have Skills
Agent Experience (AX) Design, Process Mapping/Mining, MarTech and AdTech Ecosystems, Data Visualization (Tableau/Power BI)
Job Summary
Practice: I&P | Global Network - SONG | Areas of Work: Marketing Process Excellence, AI-Enabled Marketing Transformation, Future-State Marketing Process Design, Marketing Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.
As a Consultant, you will help clients reimagine how marketing work gets done across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, content, media, CRM, social, search, and measurement through process redesign, digital innovation, data-driven decision-making, and AI-powered ways of working. Operating at the intersection of customer experience, marketing, analytics, technology, and operations, you will lead workstreams, conduct capability and process assessments, define future-state processes and operating models, shape transformation roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes that improve growth, customer value, and operational effectiveness.
 You Are
You are a hands-on marketing transformation leader who can take ownership of a client workstream from diagnostic through future-state design. You combine practical knowledge of how modern marketing functions operate with structured process excellence methods, and you can translate business priorities into clear process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, and adoption requirements.
You design at the intersection of marketer, AI agent, platform, and process. You apply Agent Experience (AX) Design principles to determine where AI agents can support or automate work, where human judgment is essential, and how roles, controls, escalation, and handoffs should be designed to improve speed, quality, compliance, and business outcomes.
Roles & Responsibilities
Use AI tools across research, analysis, design, and deliverable creation, and identify opportunities to embed AI and agentic solutions into redesigned marketing processes. As a Consultant, you will be expected to independently lead workstreams, facilitate client discussions, and convert analysis into implementation-ready recommendations. Your responsibilities include:
Marketing Transformation & Benchmarking
• Assess marketing trends, customer and channel shifts, and peer practices to identify process reinvention opportunities across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, campaign planning, content operations, media, CRM/lifecycle marketing, social and influencer marketing, search, marketing operations, and measurement.
• Lead capability and process diagnostics and benchmarking to identify performance gaps, pain points, control issues, duplication, and opportunities to improve productivity, speed-to-market, customer experience, marketing effectiveness, and cost efficiency.
• Build data-driven assessments and executive-ready insights using AI-assisted analysis and visualization tools, translating findings into clear transformation priorities.
Future-State Marketing Process Design
• Lead future-state marketing process and operating model design covering AI integration points, workflow automation, decision rights, governance, human-machine interaction, platform enablement, measurement, and workforce adoption.
• Lead client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; facilitate co-creation across marketing, content, media, CRM, analytics, technology, and operations teams; and present recommendations to senior client stakeholders.

title: Project Leader (IP & Delivery) - Strategy & Transformation CoE
description:
About us
Bain & Company is a global management consulting that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries.
