In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
Who you will work with
Strategy and Transformation (S&T) CoE regularly collaborates with Sr. stakeholders (Sr. Partners, EVPs) from Bain’s Strategy & Transformation Practice and works with Bain case teams across the globe on strategy / transformation case requirements.
The work spans across industries with variety of analysis including but not limited to industry/sector analysis and scans, analyzing disruptive themes and evolving start-up ecosystem, Investment analysis, M&A and Corporate venture capital Scans, Digital heuristics identifying key trends/drivers/challenges, survey analysis, etc.
Additionally, the team also supports Global S&T Practice in managing CEO Forums and Podcasts that entails developing IPs / POVs / Tools and managing communication with senior Bain Stakeholders, including Partners, Practice leadership as well as Marketing team and third-party vendors.
What you’ll do 
• This is a Project Leader role within the Strategy & Transformation (S&T) CoE at BCN, partnering with senior leaders across Bain’s global S&T practice, including Partners and EVPs, and with case teams across industries and geographies
• The role is designed for a proactive, ownership-oriented individual who can operate as an individual subject-matter and delivery expert - independently taking complex, high-priority work from an initial question through to a high-quality outcome; the Project Leader will work with a Manager/Senior Manager for strategic thought partnership and selectively leverage junior team members where needed
• A core part of the role is working with Bain’s S&T leaders to develop differentiated perspectives and intellectual property (IP) on the issues shaping the S&T agenda - these may include industry and sector shifts, disruptive business trends, emerging business models, innovation and startup ecosystems, VC/PE investment landscapes, and account full-potential opportunities; the role will turn these insights into compelling Bain perspectives, commercial assets and, where relevant, support client work
• The Project Leader will also bring an AI-enabled delivery mindset, proactively using GenAI, automation and emerging tools to create repeatable workflows and solutions that improve the quality, speed and scalability of the work
SCOPE OF WORK
• Lead complex workstreams end-to-end – structure ambiguous questions, develop hypotheses, define the approach, synthesize evidence and drive the work through to clear, actionable outcomes
• Build differentiated perspectives and IP – partner with senior S&T leaders to identify important questions, develop new points of view, and translate research and analysis into compelling executive content and commercial assets
• Apply insights to client and commercial priorities – bring relevant industry, market and S&T perspectives to priority case work, proposals, account for full-potential opportunities, and client-development efforts
• Drive stakeholder alignment and execution – work confidently with Partners and case-team leaders, clarify expectations, anticipate issues and keep complex workstreams moving
• Use AI to improve and scale delivery – identify opportunities to build reusable AI-enabled workflows, tools and analytical solutions while maintaining strong judgment and quality control
• Leverage junior team members where required, while remaining personally accountable for the overall answer and quality of delivery
About you
We are looking for a proactive, ownership-oriented and solution-driven individual who can independently make progress in ambiguous situations, form an independent point of view and build credibility with senior stakeholders
You will bring:
• 4-7 years of relevant professional experience after a Master’s/postgraduate degree, ideally in consulting, strategy, business research, knowledge services or a comparable professional-services environment
• Demonstrated ability to independently own complex, high-priority workstreams end-to-end, with a strong bias toward action and outcomes
• Strong problem solving and business judgment, with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar industries, business models and strategic questions
• Excellent research, analytical and synthesis skills, with the ability to translate diverse sources of evidence into differentiated insights and executive-ready perspectives
• Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the maturity and confidence to work directly with Partners, senior case-team leaders and geographically dispersed stakeholders
• Strong work-planning and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities in fast-moving environments
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset — anticipating needs, finding practical ways forward and taking initiative rather than waiting for detailed direction
• A strong AI and innovation orientation, with interest or experience in using GenAI, automation and emerging tools to create repeatable solutions and new ways of working.
• Ability to guide junior team members when needed, while remaining hands-on and accountable for the overall answer and quality of delivery
• Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills; experience with automation, AI-enabled tool development, agentic workflows is an advantage

title: Project Leader- Healthcare (MedTech)
description:
ABOUT US:  
Bain & Company is a global consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property.
WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:
This is a full-time position based in Bain’s Gurugram office and forms an integral part of the Healthcare & Life Sciences Centre of Expertise (HLS CoE). The HLS CoE provides specialized support to global consulting teams across the healthcare and life sciences value chain, enabling clients to make strategic business and investment decisions. The team partners closely with case teams as a thought-partner, delivering high-quality, industry-specific analytical products and expertise to address the most critical strategic questions facing Bain’s healthcare clients.
The HLS practice serves leading organizations across Pharmaceuticals, MedTech, Providers, Payers, Global Health, and Digital Health. As part of the HLS CoE, you will collaborate with teams across all major regions (EMEA, Americas, and APAC) in a fast-paced, dynamic environment—working closely with global Bain teams to deliver impactful results for our clients.
Role:
We are looking for a high performing Project Leader to lead a team of 3-4 members focused on MedTech (Medical Devices, Equipment’s, OEMs, Distribution etc.) as a subsector with HLS. A Project Leader (PL) is responsible for ensuring high quality delivery of projects while building strong client relationships and providing day to day coaching and mentoring to team members. The PL works with his/her team to build direction and work-plan, approach to problem solving, hypothesis generation by leveraging the research toolkit. 
 In this role, you will lead a team comprising Associates and Analysts to deliver high-impact, client-ready proposals, case specific outputs, and go-to-market materials. You will also support the development of intellectual property (IP), thought leadership, and Bain’s internal capabilities. The role requires strong problem-solving skills, understanding of healthcare landscape, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across levels. The PL is also expected to participate in office initiatives such as recruiting, training, and business strategy.
Key responsibilities
• Lead a case/ proposal engagement for our MedTech clients
• Collaborate with Partners/case teams to deliver active cases and develop proposals with domain specific insights in a client ready format
• Engage with Practice leadership on evolving IP/existing products; and ideate in developing new products/IP for Healthcare clients
• Build a strong understanding of MedTech IPs and concepts within the team
• Drive structured problem solving and storytelling for client situations and ensure alignment with Bain’s quality standards
• Provide direct, day-to-day management to a group of 3-4 team members with limited guidance from the Manager
• Ensuring timely, high-quality delivery to clients through effective team management; creating hypothesis; defining deliverables and design outputs; drawing the structure and plan; prioritizing and setting daily timelines; reviewing the team’s output, providing feedback and ensuring quality control
• Identify and proactively engage on critical issues on projects and with clients; proactively resolve problems, remove roadblocks, and escalate issues as needed
• Is proficient at identifying and using the relevant analytical tools and ensures zero-defect in all work streams and ensures quality work delivery; Wherever needed, leverages advanced tools (Tableau, Alteryx, Python, R, SPSS) to improve team efficiency
• Foster collaboration with other BCN and global teams to ensure knowledge sharing
• Own and maintain client relationships
• Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations.
• Communicate data, knowledge, and clearly explain insights and implications for the client to the entire team; Generate and screen realistic answers based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions. 
• Effectively manage client and team meetings and deliver clear and professional presentations to the team, team leaders and managers/partners across the Bain system.
• Exerts strong positive influence over developing and retaining top talent 
• Develop professional development plans, provide coaching/training, recognize accomplishments of direct reports
• Provides day-to-day coaching on work-planning, problem solving, hypothesis generation and research toolkit
• Ability to build connect with the team members through a trust-based relationship at all levels is a must. Acts as a role model and brand ambassador of the Bain culture
• Constructively engages in mutual feedback process with supervisor and direct reportees; provides concrete, regular and actionable feedback
• Deliver performance reviews and recommends ratings
ABOUT YOU: 
1. Experience & Education
• Undergraduate degree (bachelor’s in medicine, pharma, Biomedical, Biotechnology engineering or other science/medical related fields) with 5–8 years of relevant experience in a global professional services environment, with exposure to business research, analytics, and consulting in the MedTech/Healthcare domain
• Postgraduate degree (master’s or equivalent) with 3–6 years of relevant experience in MedTech consulting services
• Strong academic track record and demonstrated analytical excellence
• Proven experience in consulting or proposal development, preferably within the Healthcare and Life Sciences domain
2. Leadership & Team Management
• Demonstrated ability to manage and motivate teams, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality outputs under tight deadlines
• Maturity to lead by example, balancing attention to detail with effective delegation
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and geographies
3. Core Skills & Personal Attributes
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to drive senior client and stakeholder discussions
• Ability to deal with ambiguity and translate open-ended ideas into practical, actionable results
• A strong team player with proven interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted working relationships
• Proficient in both written and spoken English
4. Domain & Technical Expertise
• Deep expertise across the MedTech value chain, including market dynamics, customer segments, regulatory and reimbursement environments, key OEMs, portfolio optimization, and growth and competitive strategy, with a strong end-to-end perspective on the sector
• Experience leading MedTech strategy engagements, including growth strategy, portfolio rationalization, M&A commercial diligence, and post-merger integration

Prior experience or familiarity with Alteryx, any BI tool, and working with large datasets is essential.
• The incumbent should be a graduate or postgraduate from a top-tier institute or have pursued a commerce, statistical, or analytical course from a Tier 1 university.

This involves maintaining a comprehensive understanding of industry trends, updating forecasts, and providing analytical support through reports and publications.

• Proficiency in research and analysis, with a basic understanding of aviation datasets from Aviation Week, IATA, Cirium, etc.

• Demonstrate independent secondary research, analytical, and storylining skills.

• Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage

• Strong command on verbal and written English language.
• Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
• Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
• 5-7 years’ Work Experience
• CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification
Certifications:
• Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
• Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

title: Project Lead / Senior Consultant
description:
Role: Project Lead || Senior Consultant
Location: Gurugram, Sector - 49
Mode of Work: On-site (5 Days)
Department: Consulting
Reporting To: Engagement Manager/Principal
Employment Type: Permanent
Keka Link to apply for the job: https://kenresearch.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/21095
Role Overview:
The Project Lead will act as the central owner of research and consulting projects, ensuring smooth execution, quality delivery, and client satisfaction. While not directly involved in conducting primary or secondary research, the role is pivotal in planning, overseeing, and driving cross-functional project teams toward timely and impactful outcomes. The Project Lead will collaborate closely with internal teams and clients, owning the entire delivery lifecycle with a strong focus on execution excellence and stakeholder management.
What will you be doing?
End-to-End Project Ownership
• Own the complete delivery lifecycle of consulting and research engagements.
• Translate client requirements into clear project plans with defined timelines, milestones, and roles.
• Ensure on-time, high-quality delivery through continuous tracking and risk management.
• Coordinate across research, analytics, and editorial teams to align on deliverables.
Client Delivery Management
• Serve as the single point of accountability for client communication during project execution.
• Conduct regular update calls, clarify deliverables, gather feedback, and realign expectations 
• Ensure that final deliverables meet client expectations, with a focus on insight-driven 
recommendations.
Team Leadership & Coordination
• Lead cross-functional teams by allocating responsibilities and setting clear priorities.
• Review team outputs regularly to ensure consistency, structure, and alignment with project 
objectives.
• Coach junior team members on best practices and guide them through delivery challenges.
Quality & Strategic Oversight
• Own the quality control process across all key client-facing outputs.
• Ensure that reports and presentations are aligned with client objectives and project scope.
• Escalate potential risks or scope deviations early and propose mitigation plans.
Internal Collaboration & Process Improvement
• Contribute to refining internal delivery processes, templates, and tools.
• Share project learnings and best practices to enhance organizational capabilities
Qualification & Experience
• Master’s or bachelor’s degree from a reputed institute, preferably in Business, Economics, or related fields, 
• 4+ years of experience in research and consulting project management within top-tier consulting firms or high-growth advisory environments. Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams, owning client delivery, and ensuring high-quality execution in deadline-driven settings.
About Company:
At Ken Research, our clients come first. Since 2011, we have empowered businesses with high-quality insights for lasting success. Our global team of experts collaborates with clients to address unique challenges, offering reliable solutions across sectors like healthcare, finance, and technology. We prioritize integrity, transparency, and dedication, ensuring excellence in every project. We measure our success by our clients' success, consistently delivering precise research that drives competitive advantage. Our commitment to quality and client satisfaction makes us a trusted partner worldwide.

title: EY- Process and Controls - Risk Consulting - IA Capital Projects - Senior
description:

EY- Process & Controls – Risk Consulting – Senior - IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your Key Responsibilities
The role requires supporting and executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate and construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
• Execute assigned workstreams in client engagements and coordinate effectively with the onsite team across the MENA region.
• Interact professionally with client stakeholders and support discussions with senior management.
• Perform end-to-end internal audit activities, including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrices and audit work programs, control testing, documentation of findings, and preparation of draft reports.
• Apply knowledge of risks, issues, trends, and end-to-end business processes in the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction sectors.
• Support reviews of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
• Review capital project business cases, including key assumptions, structure, and feasibility.
• Perform audit procedures covering engineering, planning, and cost-related areas, including master planning, engineering phases, stage-gate methods, and design maturity.
• Apply cost-estimating principles, cost-estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and undertake BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
• Review procurement, contract, and commercial practices and apply project-control principles relating to schedule, cost, risk, and reporting.
• Analyze the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, and risk plans, and interpret contracts, reports, and dashboards.
• Review resource plans and schedules to assess their alignment with project objectives.
• Complete assigned work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, and promptly escalate issues to engagement leadership.
• Identify process improvement opportunities and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
• Support business development activities, including research, proposal preparation, and development of marketing collateral.
• Comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies at all times.
• Manage multiple assigned tasks and workstreams under the guidance of engagement leadership.
• Maintain proactive communication and professional working relationships with clients and team members.
• Guide junior team members on assigned tasks and review their work where required.
• Support engagement administration, budget monitoring, methodology development, and preparation of new solutions.
Skills And Attributes For Success
• Excellent command of spoken and written English
• Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at short notice
• Strong analytical, organizational, and consulting skills
• Ability to manage assigned workstreams, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of deliverables
• Ability to multitask and deliver quality work under tight deadlines
• Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
• Attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Proficiency in MS Office Suite, data analysis, and validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit or Risk Management, preferably within the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
• Experience executing or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, or project controls.
• Ability to interpret and assess project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
• A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.
What Working At EY Offers
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
• The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

title: Senior Consultant
description:
Job Description: Senior Technology Consultant – Capital Markets (Calypso Specialist)
Job Purpose:
• Need to work as a Senior Technology Consultant in the capacity of Capital Market – Calypso Implementation Specialist in Capital Market core modernisation and migration projects.
• Should exhibit deep experience in financial services during the client discussions and be able to convince the client on the solution.
1. Work Experience Requirements
a. Functional Experience
• 4 to 8 years of hands‑on experience in Capital Markets with strong exposure to Front‑to‑Back trade lifecycle.
• Solid understanding of:
• Securities trading, settlements, confirmations, reconciliation, and clearing.
• Middle‑office processes including trade validation, enrichment, allocation, and reporting.
• Regulatory reporting and compliance across capital markets.
• Demonstrates experience interacting with business stakeholders, product controllers, operations, and risk teams.
• Prior exposure to transformation, modernization, or migration programs in Capital Markets.
b. Technical Experience
• Strong implementation experience in Calypso, particularly Version 14+ (preferred), across:
• System configuration in trading, static data, settlement, and middle‑office modules.
• Workflow design and exception handling.
• Integration with upstream and downstream systems.
• Hands‑on experience with:
• Trade processing engines
• Static and reference data frameworks
• Interfaces, messaging standards (ISO15022/20022, FIX), and APIs
• Experience working in Agile environments and contributing to functional & technical design workshops.
2. Mandatory Skills
a. Functional Skills
• Calypso platform expertise, including:
• Calypso Securities Instance (CSI)
• Trade Representation & Processing
• Static Data Configuration
• Workflow creation & orchestration
• Trade Validation & Enrichment logic
• Loss & Claim Management module
• Settlement Status Processing
• Middle Office Reporting Framework
• Block Allocation – Vinci SS1 enrichment
• Archiving concepts and strategy
• Ability to write and analyze SQL queries.
• Good understanding of system integration, APIs (SOAP/REST), and messaging.
• Ability to interpret technical logs, troubleshoot issues, and guide development teams.
• Strong knowledge of financial instruments:
• Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Listed & OTC Derivatives, Repos, and Structured Products.
• Understanding of:
• Trade lifecycle from booking to settlement
• Risk factors, pricing inputs, and PnL drivers
• Collateral management fundamentals
• Treasury and liquidity processes
• Experience in requirements gathering, gap analysis (OOTB vs. custom), and functional documentation.
• Exposure to Agile delivery models (Scrum/Kanban).
b. Technical Skills
• Application and Solution (workflow, interface) technical design.
• Business requirements, definition, analysis, and mapping.
• Understanding of technology landscape and providing system configuration design in Market, Static and Reference data.
• Knowledge of databases, infrastructure, application servers, Technical Architecture, Security and Performance management.
• Expertise in writing integration specifications and knowledge of Soap or Rest APIs.
• One or more of following Tech skill categories:
• Database skills – Able to write SQL queries of moderate complexity,
• Programming/ Scripting skills: One of {Python, Java, C#} - able to write methods calling APIs
• Experience in Cloud and CI/CD (Devops Automation environment)
• Data Visualization – Dashboard analysis with Tableau, Power Bi
3. Preferred Work Location
• This position offers flexibility to work from any EY GDS office in India
4. Education and Experience
• MBA / MCA / BE / BTech or equivalent degree.
• 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Capital Markets, preferably within banking, investment banking, or financial technology domains.

title: RC-Risk Management-ERM-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY – Risk Consulting – Manager, Enterprise Risk Management
As part of Risk Consulting, you will lead and support client engagements focused on Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), risk governance and GRC transformation across the MENA region. You will work with clients across sectors and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design practical, sustainable and technology-enabled risk management solutions.
The opportunity
We are looking for an experienced professional with a strong background in Enterprise Risk Management to join our Risk Management team. This is an opportunity to contribute to the growth of a leading risk advisory practice while helping clients strengthen risk-informed decision-making, resilience and governance. The position will be based in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will advise clients across a variety of industries and operating environments, lead high-quality engagements and develop your experience in ERM frameworks, risk appetite, risk reporting, risk culture and GRC solutions.
Your Key Responsibilities
As part of the role, you will:
• Lead and manage ERM, risk governance and GRC advisory engagements from planning through delivery.
• Design, implement and enhance ERM frameworks aligned with recognised standards such as ISO 31000 and COSO ERM.
• Facilitate enterprise-wide risk assessments, risk workshops and risk identification sessions with senior stakeholders.
• Develop and maintain risk taxonomies, enterprise and functional risk registers, risk appetite statements, tolerance thresholds and key risk indicators.
• Integrate risk management into strategy, business planning, budgeting, performance management and decision-making processes.
• Establish risk monitoring, escalation and reporting mechanisms, including executive and Board-level dashboards.
• Assess strategic, operational, financial, technology, cyber, regulatory, third-party, sustainability and emerging risks.
• Review risk governance structures, management and Board risk committee arrangements and alignment with the three-lines model.
• Lead risk maturity assessments, benchmarking exercises and ERM transformation programmes, and develop pragmatic improvement roadmaps.
• Support the evaluation, design and implementation of GRC technology solutions and risk data visualisation.
• Advise on operational resilience, business continuity and crisis risk management frameworks, where relevant.
• Manage engagement scope, economics, resources, risks, quality, timelines and client expectations.
• Build trusted relationships with senior management, risk committees and other key stakeholders, translating complex risk matters into clear recommendations.
• Coach and mentor team members and foster a culture of quality, collaboration and continuous learning.
• Develop proposals, thought leadership and go-to-market initiatives that support the growth of the ERM practice.
Skills And Attributes For Success
• Strong knowledge of ERM frameworks, risk governance, risk appetite, risk culture, risk reporting and the three-lines model.
• Ability to translate complex risk information into concise executive and Board-level reporting.
• Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proven project and engagement management capability, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight deadlines.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with confidence presenting to senior management and governance forums.
• Strong proposal development, account management and business development capabilities.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with data analytics, Power BI or GRC platforms would be advantageous.

We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your Key Responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
• Responsible for leading and executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
• Ability to interact with all levels of management, including C-Suite executives.
• Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
• Have an in-depth understanding of the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction industry risks/issues/trends and end-to-end business processes.
• Demonstrate knowledge and experience of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, including understanding of governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
• Assess business cases for capital projects, analyzing their structure, assumptions, and feasibility.
• Lead audits with engineering, planning, or cost-related components, including review of master planning, engineering phases, stage gate methods, and design maturity.
• Understand cost estimating principles, cost estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and perform BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
• Evaluate procurement, contract, and commercial practices, and apply project control principles (schedule, cost, risk, reporting).
• Analyze integrity, completeness and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, risk plans, and interpret project documentation such as contracts, reports, and dashboards.
• Review and interpret resource plans and schedules to assess alignment with project objectives.
• Deliver/manage engagements on time, within budget, and at high quality.
• Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value through insightful recommendations.
• Contribute to business development activities such as proposal preparation and lead identification.
• Always comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies.
• Manage multiple assignments and associated project teams.
• Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with clients.
• Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet performance goals and grow their careers.
• Manage engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, proposals, and new solutions/methodologies.
Skills And Attributes For Success
• Exceptional command on spoken and written English
• Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice
• Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
• Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
• Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
• Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
• Attention to detail and quality assurance
• Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience in Internal Audit / Risk Management, with a focus on the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
• Experience leading or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, and project controls.
• Ability to interpret and assess detailed project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
• A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

title: FS-RISK CONSULTING-FSRM - Basel III Business Analyst _CSTC-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior
Description
EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.
Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end-to-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
• Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery & Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
• Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
• Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
• Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
• Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators
Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
Role Overview
The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.
Key Responsibilities
• Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
• Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
• Perform data profiling and fit-for-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
• Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA-CCR, and operational risk.
• Develop source-to-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
• Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source-to-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
• Map data elements to Axiom-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.
• Assist in the design, build, and testing of interim ERBA calculators using available UCL data and direct source-system data until strategic UCL feeds are available.
• Support testing of calculator outputs, reconciliation of data and results, fit-for-use analysis, issue identification, remediation tracking, and user acceptance testing using project accelerators and agreed testing approaches.
• Identify and document controls for new or modified data elements, including preventative and detective controls, data quality checks, lineage controls, reconciliation points, and governance documentation.
• Recommend interim and strategic BAU data capture, data management, and process enhancements to support ERBA, SCCL gross exposure measurements, regulatory reporting, management reporting, and future-state capital insights.
• Coordinate with exposure pods, technology teams, and business stakeholders to drive agile execution across discovery, assessment, design, build, testing, and refinement sprints.
• Prepare clear, executive-ready documentation including requirements packs, mapping documents, control matrices, testing summaries, issue trackers, status decks, and steering committee materials.
• Responsibly use AI and automation tools to improve analysis, documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and delivery transparency while following engagement and client requirements.
Qualifications, Certifications And Education
Must-have:
• Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering, statistics, information systems, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in banking, consulting, risk management, regulatory capital, data management, or regulatory reporting.
• Strong understanding of Basel III / Basel III Endgame / Basel III Proposal requirements, ERBA concepts, RWA calculations, regulatory capital, credit risk, counterparty credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory reporting processes.
• Experience supporting Basel implementation, gap assessments, regulatory capital transformation, data sourcing, calculation logic documentation, data quality remediation, or regulatory reporting change programs.
• Strong business and data analysis skills, including requirements documentation, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, data lineage, data dictionaries, metadata management, reconciliation, and control documentation.
• Ability to understand exposure-level requirements across residential mortgage, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet exposures, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, SA-CCR, and operational risk.
• Experience working with senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Credit, Technology, Data, Operations, Compliance, and business teams in a structured and professional manner.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical data, logic, controls, testing, and implementation deliverables.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in preparing executive-ready PowerPoint materials, Excel trackers, meeting notes, governance reports, requirements documents, and testing summaries.
• Demonstrated focus on delivery excellence, attention to detail, process discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.
Good-to-have:
• Experience with Axiom, regulatory capital calculators, RWA engines, regulatory reporting platforms, or capital data warehouses.
• Technical skills such as SQL, SAS, Python, advanced Excel, data profiling tools, data visualization tools, or cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, GCP, or similar environments.
• Familiarity with UCL / data factory delivery concepts, source-to-target reconciliation, consumption views, semantic layers, data model design, ADRS unification, and ETL design documentation.
• Familiarity with SA-CCR, SCCL, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, securitization capital rules, corporate / wholesale banking products, and operational risk SMA / BIC concepts.
• Certifications such as FRM, CFA, PRM, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / Scrum, DAMA, or other relevant risk, data, or project delivery credentials.
• Hands-on experience with project management, collaboration, and reporting tools such as MS Project, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
• Prior consulting experience or experience working with US banks, regional banks, global financial institutions, or regulatory-driven change and remediation programs.

We are looking for an experienced professional with a strong background in Enterprise Risk Management to join our Risk Management team. The position will be based in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will advise clients across a variety of industries and operating environments, lead high-quality engagements and develop your experience in ERM frameworks, risk appetite, risk reporting, risk culture and GRC solutions.

• Lead and manage ERM, risk governance and GRC advisory engagements from planning through delivery.

• Integrate risk management into strategy, business planning, budgeting, performance management and decision-making processes.

• Advise on operational resilience, business continuity and crisis risk management frameworks, where relevant.
• Manage engagement scope, economics, resources, risks, quality, timelines and client expectations.
• Build trusted relationships with senior management, risk committees and other key stakeholders, translating complex risk matters into clear recommendations.

• Strong knowledge of ERM frameworks, risk governance, risk appetite, risk culture, risk reporting and the three-lines model.

• Proven project and engagement management capability, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight deadlines.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with confidence presenting to senior management and governance forums.
• Strong proposal development, account management and business development capabilities.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with data analytics, Power BI or GRC platforms would be advantageous.
• Knowledge of regulatory environments and risk practices across the MENA region would be advantageous.
To qualify for the role, you must have
• A bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or a related discipline.
• A minimum of eight years of relevant experience, including experience managing ERM or risk advisory engagements.
• Demonstrable experience in risk assessments, risk appetite, KRIs, risk reporting, governance and ERM improvement initiatives.
• Experience managing teams and engaging with senior client stakeholders.

• A relevant professional certification such as CRMA, CIA, FRM, CRM, RIMS-CRMP, CISA, ACCA, CA or an equivalent risk, audit, finance or governance qualification.
• Prior consulting or professional-services experience.
• A master’s degree or MBA.
• Arabic language capability, where relevant to client engagements in the MENA region.
• Mobility and travel
• Willingness and ability to travel to client locations, sometimes at short notice.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Consultant - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
YOU ARE
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development
• Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. 
• Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. 
• Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. 
• Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

title: GN-I&E- Comms and Media Lean Telco Manager
description:
Analyst & Consultant | S&C GN - Non-Network
Management Level
Level 11 to 09
Location
Bangalore / Gurgaon / Pune
Entity
S&C GN - Non Network
Job Summary
As a Lean Telco Analyst / Consultant, you will help Communications & Media clients design and execute large-scale business and operating model transformations across the offerings of Lean Telco strategy and roadmap, Company-wide re-invention, telco restructuring and carve-outs, NetCo/ServCo separation, B2C care reinvention, B2B sales process reinvention, Process Driven IT Reinvention and AI-enabled operational improvement.
You will own defined modules or workstreams focused on assessing current-state operations, processes and operating models; defining future-state and North Star target states; developing value and business cases; and designing transformation roadmaps and implementation plans that deliver measurable business outcomes.
Must-Have Skills
Cross-Cutting Industry & Consulting Skills
•  Understanding of telecom operating models, value chains and functional processes across BSS, OSS, CRM, Order management, billing, provisioning, assurance, customer operations etc.
•  Familiarity with process discovery, BPMN-based process mapping, process mining and value realization concepts
•  AI Fluency (fundamentals of AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI concepts) and ability to identify and qualify AI/agentic use cases within client engagements.
•  Strong strategic analysis and structured problem-solving skills, including hypothesis-led issue framing, research, benchmarking, data interpretation and data-driven decision making
•  Strong quantitative analysis, Excel-based modelling and business case development capabilities
•  Excellent PowerPoint storytelling, presentation development and executive communication skills
•  Experience supporting proposals, POVs, thought leadership and/or practice/capability development initiatives
Must-Have Skills by capability area
You are expected to possess proven experience and skills in one or more of the following capability areas
Lean Telco Strategy & Roadmap
•  Experience supporting Lean Telco strategy and roadmap engagements spanning transformation ambition definition, North star definition, operating model assessment, value architecture development and roadmap creation
•  Ability to assess current-state telecom operating models and performance drivers to identify transformation opportunities
•  Experience developing value cases, business cases, benefits baselines and value realization frameworks
•  Ability to support governance, KPI and value tracking mechanisms to drive realization of transformation outcomes
•  Exposure to AI-first telco operating model concepts – where AI/agentic capabilities are designed into the target operating model from the outset
Process-Driven Reinvention
Business Reinvention
•  Experience leading telecom process assessments, value discovery and eTOM-based business process transformation
•  Ability to redesign customer journeys, operating models and As-Is/To-Be processes across care, sales and commercial functions
•  Experience in B2C care transformation, including AI-assisted contact centers, digital self-service, Customer 360 and workforce optimization
•  Experience in B2B sales transformation across lead-to-cash, quote-to-cash and order-to-cash processes, including CRM/CPQ enablement and revenue leakage reduction
•  Ability to identify AI and automation opportunities, develop business cases, and drive value realization for transformation programs
IT Reinvention
•  Experience supporting IT and telecom operations transformation across BSS/OSS and enterprise IT processes
•  Understanding of IT operating models, ITSM frameworks and service management processes
•  Knowledge of target operating model designs for IT and service management organizations
•  Experience assessing and defining future states across ITSM processes including incident, request, problem and change management
•  Experience performing gap analysis and opportunity identification for workflow automation, orchestration, AIOps and AI-enabled IT operations
•  Familiarity with eTOM, ITIL and service management frameworks
Telecom Restructuring & Carve-outs
•  Working knowledge of telco restructuring and carve-outs, including business separation, Transition Services Agreement (TSA) / service model, transition planning and commercial interface considerations
•  Ability to assess process, organization, technology and service dependencies across business units
•  Experience supporting service catalogue design, service management models, SLA frameworks and transition planning
•  Knowledge of operating model design, governance structures and service delivery frameworks
•  Understanding of TSA planning, Day-1 readiness activities and business transition requirements
•  Ability to support commercial, cost and synergy assessments associated with restructuring initiatives
Good-to-Have Skills
•  Hands-on exposure to AI/ML, GenAI or Agentic AI use cases in telecom operations, customer care, IT service management, sales, marketing, finance, procurement or HR
•  Hands-on exposure to GenAI/agent-builder tools, prompting, and low-code/no-code agent prototyping
•  Familiarity with telecom platforms and COTS products such as Amdocs, Ericsson, Netcracker, Subex, Salesforce, ServiceNow or similar BSS/OSS and enterprise platforms
•  Exposure to CRM, CPQ, contact center and service management platforms
•  Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Rally, MS Project, Power BI, Tableau, Excel-based models or other project management and visualization platforms
•  Experience with process mining tools such as Celonis, Signavio or similar platforms
•  Certifications such as Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, Scrum, SAFe, eTOM or PMP are advantageous
Roles & Responsibilities
•  Own defined modules or workstreams within Lean Telco engagements, from current state assessments to future state definition through recommendation development and execution planning
•  Develop fact bases, process maps, maturity assessments, benchmark comparisons, cost/productivity analyses and value hypotheses across telecom functions
•  Build business cases, value driver trees, KPI baselines and benefit tracking mechanisms to support value realization and transformation governance.
•  Prepare client-ready deliverables including executive slides, analysis packs, implementation roadmaps, RAID logs, initiative trackers, workshop materials and POV content
•  Contribute to business development, proposals, reusable assets, knowledge management and Lean Telco capability-building activities
Additional Information
This position is based at our Bengaluru/Gurgaon/Pune office. About Accenture

About Accenture:
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions – underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network – Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With more than 394,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com.
About Global Network:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, every business is a digital business. Digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities how they manufacture and deliver products and services, and how they run their organizations. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment.
To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Global Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Approximately 3,000 consultants are part of this rapidly expanding network, providing specialized and strategic industry and functional consulting expertise from key locations around the world. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit www.accenture.com/capabilitynetwork.

Why Technology Consulting
The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.
As technology rapidly evolves, it’s more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the client’s toughest business problems.
Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world's leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:
Helping Clients: Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments with a value focused approach.
Transforming Businesses: Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today's connected landscape of disruptive technologies
Principal Duties 
And Responsibilities:
Working closely with our clients, Consulting professionals design, build and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance. They develop specialized expertise—strategic, industry, functional, technical—in a diverse project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.
The opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives are limitless in this ever-changing business and technology landscape.
Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities:
• Conduct/facilitate value discovery workshops to identify and analyze the business objectives during the business blueprint phase
• Create detailed business cases for the client’s transformation initiatives – working with business and functional leaders to track and report actual performance, ensuring completeness and accuracy
• Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to drive the measurement, reporting and analysis of business metrics and analytics
• Devise, measure and report on key performance metrics (KPIs), and design reporting dashboards to measure value created for the business
• Conduct assessments, analyze data, and collaborate with various internal and external partners to identify areas for improvement and value realization.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Manager - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development
• Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. 
• Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. 
• Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. 
• Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. 
Client Engagement & Advisory Support
• Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. 
• Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. 
• Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. 
• Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. 
Data & AI Foundations
• Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. 
• Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. 
• Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. 
• Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: I&P GN - Song – Service- Manager - Process Excellence-PE
description:
GN SONG Commerce - Process Excellence - Consultant
Job Title: GN SONG Commerce - Process Excellence - Consultant
Management Level: 09 / Consultant
Location: Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai
Must Have Skills: Commerce Process Redesign, AI & Automation in Commerce, Benchmarking & Change-Impact Analysis
Good to Have Skills: AX Design, Commerce & Content Platforms (PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS), Data Visualization (Tableau / Power BI), AI Discoverability & GEO Concepts
Job Summary
Practice: I&P | Global Network SONG Commerce | Areas of Work: Commerce Process Excellence, AI-Enabled Commerce Transformation, Future-State Commerce Process Design, Commerce Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.
In this role, you will produce rigorous analytical work across commerce functions — assessing how AI is reshaping the commerce operating model, designing future-state commerce processes, and building the deliverables that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations for clients. You are expected to bring a developing point of view on how AI and automation can reinvent the way commerce organizations manage content, discoverability, assortment, pricing, channels, and fulfilment — and to actively leverage AI tools in every aspect of your work.
You Are
You produce solid analytical work — assessing the trends and forces reshaping commerce, designing future-state content, digital shelf and channel operations processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in commerce platforms, data-driven performance management, and the operating models that underpin modern commerce — and you have a point of view on how AI is changing all of it.
You understand that designing how AI agents interact within commerce processes — from content enrichment and digital shelf monitoring to assortment, pricing, and order orchestration — is just as important as the process design itself. You're starting to apply AX Design principles in your work, ensuring that how AI agents behave within each commerce workflow is as intentional as the workflow itself.
Areas of Work
Commerce Process Excellence — Commerce Operating Model, Commerce Content & Experience Design, Off-Platform & AI Discoverability, Commerce Intelligence & Optimization, Agentic Commerce Operations
Roles & Responsibilities
As part of the team, you will utilize AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation — including building agents and other tools — to drive the following:
Commerce Trends, Forces & Benchmarking
•  Produce trend and forces assessments for commerce functions — covering shifts in shopper behaviour, channel and marketplace dynamics, platform evolution, data and privacy regulation, and the growing role of AI and agents in commerce operations.
•  Conduct benchmarking analyses that show where the client's commerce organization stands relative to peers across dimensions such as content quality and completeness, digital shelf performance, discoverability, conversion, operational efficiency, and AI adoption.
•  Build analytical frameworks using AI-assisted data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, GenAI synthesis platforms) to surface reinvention opportunities across the commerce value chain.
Future-State Commerce Process Design
•  Design future-state process specifications for core commerce workflows — including product content creation and enrichment, digital shelf and channel operations, merchandising and assortment, pricing and promotions, order management, and performance measurement — covering AI integration points, platform requirements, human-machine interaction design, and workforce adoption approaches.
•  Map current-state commerce operating models and identify where AI-enabled automation, intelligent decisioning, and real-time optimization can drive step-change improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.
•  Apply commerce domain knowledge to review and improve function-specific reinvention designs, capability frameworks, and commerce playbook content.
•  Support delivery of digital and platform solutions — including PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS, marketplace and retail media ecosystems — across client engagements.
Change Impact & Commerce Capability Analysis
•  Develop change-impact assessments for commerce transformation initiatives — documenting implications for roles, team structures, operating rhythms, governance, and capability requirements as AI is embedded into commerce workflows.
•  Contribute to the reference library and keep commerce domain expertise current through continuous learning and assigned development modules.
AX Design Application in Commerce
•  Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs across commerce processes — defining how AI agents should behave within each step of the commerce lifecycle, what they handle autonomously (e.g., content variant generation, digital shelf monitoring, price and availability checks), and when they hand off to a human practitioner.
•  Ensure AX Design documentation is embedded within commerce process specifications and is consistent across all content, channel, and platform deliverables.
Professional & Technical Skills
•  1-4 years of experience in commerce transformation, digital commerce, process excellence, or management consulting with a commerce focus — with increasing independence across engagements.
•  Demonstrated experience producing commerce trend analyses, benchmarking outputs, capability assessments, or change-impact assessments for senior stakeholder review.
•  Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into commerce process design — including AI-driven content production, automated digital shelf management, intelligent pricing and assortment decisioning, and agent-assisted shopper journeys.
•  Familiarity with the commerce technology ecosystem: product information and asset management (PIM, DAM), content management, order management (OMS), marketplace and retail media platforms, and analytics tools.
•  Working understanding of AI-driven discovery and off-platform visibility — including AI-ready product content, structured product data and knowledge foundations, and visibility across answer engines and LLM surfaces.
•  Hands-on experience using AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or performance tools; comfortable synthesizing large data sets into clear commerce insights.
•  Ability to analyze complex commerce performance data and translate findings into structured, client-ready recommendations across process, channel mix, and operating model design.
•  Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce polished, senior-ready deliverables with limited direction.
•  Comfortable working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments with client-facing accountability.
Additional Information
•  Familiarity with process mapping or process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Signavio) applied to commerce workflows — content supply chain design, product onboarding flows, order-to-fulfilment mapping — is a strong differentiator.
•  Growing familiarity with AX Design concepts as applied to commerce — specifically how AI agent behaviours, autonomy levels, and handoff protocols are designed within content, digital shelf, merchandising, and channel execution workflows.
•  Client-facing consulting or advisory experience in commerce transformation, platform enablement, or digital commerce strategy; ability to build credibility with commerce and commercial leadership.
•  Experience with end-to-end commerce operations — from product onboarding and content enrichment through activation, merchandising, measurement, and optimization — is highly desirable.
•  Familiarity with data-driven commerce concepts: product data governance, assortment and pricing analytics, digital shelf measurement, and attribution across channels.
•  Proactive approach to continuous learning; stays current on AI developments reshaping commerce, including generative AI for content, AI-driven discovery, and agent-mediated purchasing.

description:
