Job Title: GN SONG Commerce - Process Excellence - Consultant
Management Level: 09 / Consultant
Location: Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai
Must Have Skills: Commerce Process Redesign, AI & Automation in Commerce, Benchmarking & Change-Impact Analysis
Good to Have Skills: AX Design, Commerce & Content Platforms (PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS), Data Visualization (Tableau / Power BI), AI Discoverability & GEO Concepts
Job Summary
Practice: I&P | Global Network SONG Commerce | Areas of Work: Commerce Process Excellence, AI-Enabled Commerce Transformation, Future-State Commerce Process Design, Commerce Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.
In this role, you will produce rigorous analytical work across commerce functions — assessing how AI is reshaping the commerce operating model, designing future-state commerce processes, and building the deliverables that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations for clients. You are expected to bring a developing point of view on how AI and automation can reinvent the way commerce organizations manage content, discoverability, assortment, pricing, channels, and fulfilment — and to actively leverage AI tools in every aspect of your work.
You Are
You produce solid analytical work — assessing the trends and forces reshaping commerce, designing future-state content, digital shelf and channel operations processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in commerce platforms, data-driven performance management, and the operating models that underpin modern commerce — and you have a point of view on how AI is changing all of it.
You understand that designing how AI agents interact within commerce processes — from content enrichment and digital shelf monitoring to assortment, pricing, and order orchestration — is just as important as the process design itself. You're starting to apply AX Design principles in your work, ensuring that how AI agents behave within each commerce workflow is as intentional as the workflow itself.
Areas of Work
Commerce Process Excellence — Commerce Operating Model, Commerce Content & Experience Design, Off-Platform & AI Discoverability, Commerce Intelligence & Optimization, Agentic Commerce Operations
Roles & Responsibilities
As part of the team, you will utilize AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation — including building agents and other tools — to drive the following:
Commerce Trends, Forces & Benchmarking
•  Produce trend and forces assessments for commerce functions — covering shifts in shopper behaviour, channel and marketplace dynamics, platform evolution, data and privacy regulation, and the growing role of AI and agents in commerce operations.
•  Conduct benchmarking analyses that show where the client's commerce organization stands relative to peers across dimensions such as content quality and completeness, digital shelf performance, discoverability, conversion, operational efficiency, and AI adoption.
•  Build analytical frameworks using AI-assisted data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, GenAI synthesis platforms) to surface reinvention opportunities across the commerce value chain.
Future-State Commerce Process Design
•  Design future-state process specifications for core commerce workflows — including product content creation and enrichment, digital shelf and channel operations, merchandising and assortment, pricing and promotions, order management, and performance measurement — covering AI integration points, platform requirements, human-machine interaction design, and workforce adoption approaches.
•  Map current-state commerce operating models and identify where AI-enabled automation, intelligent decisioning, and real-time optimization can drive step-change improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.
•  Apply commerce domain knowledge to review and improve function-specific reinvention designs, capability frameworks, and commerce playbook content.
•  Support delivery of digital and platform solutions — including PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS, marketplace and retail media ecosystems — across client engagements.
Change Impact & Commerce Capability Analysis
•  Develop change-impact assessments for commerce transformation initiatives — documenting implications for roles, team structures, operating rhythms, governance, and capability requirements as AI is embedded into commerce workflows.
•  Contribute to the reference library and keep commerce domain expertise current through continuous learning and assigned development modules.
AX Design Application in Commerce
•  Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs across commerce processes — defining how AI agents should behave within each step of the commerce lifecycle, what they handle autonomously (e.g., content variant generation, digital shelf monitoring, price and availability checks), and when they hand off to a human practitioner.
•  Ensure AX Design documentation is embedded within commerce process specifications and is consistent across all content, channel, and platform deliverables.
Professional & Technical Skills
•  1-4 years of experience in commerce transformation, digital commerce, process excellence, or management consulting with a commerce focus — with increasing independence across engagements.
•  Demonstrated experience producing commerce trend analyses, benchmarking outputs, capability assessments, or change-impact assessments for senior stakeholder review.
•  Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into commerce process design — including AI-driven content production, automated digital shelf management, intelligent pricing and assortment decisioning, and agent-assisted shopper journeys.
•  Familiarity with the commerce technology ecosystem: product information and asset management (PIM, DAM), content management, order management (OMS), marketplace and retail media platforms, and analytics tools.
•  Working understanding of AI-driven discovery and off-platform visibility — including AI-ready product content, structured product data and knowledge foundations, and visibility across answer engines and LLM surfaces.
•  Hands-on experience using AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or performance tools; comfortable synthesizing large data sets into clear commerce insights.
•  Ability to analyze complex commerce performance data and translate findings into structured, client-ready recommendations across process, channel mix, and operating model design.
•  Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce polished, senior-ready deliverables with limited direction.
•  Comfortable working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments with client-facing accountability.
Additional Information
•  Familiarity with process mapping or process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Signavio) applied to commerce workflows — content supply chain design, product onboarding flows, order-to-fulfilment mapping — is a strong differentiator.
•  Growing familiarity with AX Design concepts as applied to commerce — specifically how AI agent behaviours, autonomy levels, and handoff protocols are designed within content, digital shelf, merchandising, and channel execution workflows.
•  Client-facing consulting or advisory experience in commerce transformation, platform enablement, or digital commerce strategy; ability to build credibility with commerce and commercial leadership.
•  Experience with end-to-end commerce operations — from product onboarding and content enrichment through activation, merchandising, measurement, and optimization — is highly desirable.
•  Familiarity with data-driven commerce concepts: product data governance, assortment and pricing analytics, digital shelf measurement, and attribution across channels.
•  Proactive approach to continuous learning; stays current on AI developments reshaping commerce, including generative AI for content, AI-driven discovery, and agent-mediated purchasing.

description:

Good to Have Skills: AX Design, Commerce & Content Platforms (PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS), Data Visualization (Tableau / Power BI), AI Discoverability & GEO Concepts
Job Summary
Practice: I&P | Global Network SONG Commerce | Areas of Work: Commerce Process Excellence, AI-Enabled Commerce Transformation, Future-State Commerce Process Design, Commerce Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.
In this role, you will produce rigorous analytical work across commerce functions — assessing how AI is reshaping the commerce operating model, designing future-state commerce processes, and building the deliverables that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations for clients. You are expected to bring a developing point of view on how AI and automation can reinvent the way commerce organizations manage content, discoverability, assortment, pricing, channels, and fulfilment — and to actively leverage AI tools in every aspect of your work.
You Are
You produce solid analytical work — assessing the trends and forces reshaping commerce, designing future-state content, digital shelf and channel operations processes, and building the supporting materials that help senior practitioners shape transformation recommendations. You're developing real expertise in commerce platforms, data-driven performance management, and the operating models that underpin modern commerce — and you have a point of view on how AI is changing all of it.
You understand that designing how AI agents interact within commerce processes — from content enrichment and digital shelf monitoring to assortment, pricing, and order orchestration — is just as important as the process design itself. You're starting to apply AX Design principles in your work, ensuring that how AI agents behave within each commerce workflow is as intentional as the workflow itself.
Areas of Work
Commerce Process Excellence — Commerce Operating Model, Commerce Content & Experience Design, Off-Platform & AI Discoverability, Commerce Intelligence & Optimization, Agentic Commerce Operations
Roles & Responsibilities
As part of the team, you will utilize AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation — including building agents and other tools — to drive the following:
Commerce Trends, Forces & Benchmarking
•  Produce trend and forces assessments for commerce functions — covering shifts in shopper behaviour, channel and marketplace dynamics, platform evolution, data and privacy regulation, and the growing role of AI and agents in commerce operations.
•  Conduct benchmarking analyses that show where the client's commerce organization stands relative to peers across dimensions such as content quality and completeness, digital shelf performance, discoverability, conversion, operational efficiency, and AI adoption.
•  Build analytical frameworks using AI-assisted data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, GenAI synthesis platforms) to surface reinvention opportunities across the commerce value chain.
Future-State Commerce Process Design
•  Design future-state process specifications for core commerce workflows — including product content creation and enrichment, digital shelf and channel operations, merchandising and assortment, pricing and promotions, order management, and performance measurement — covering AI integration points, platform requirements, human-machine interaction design, and workforce adoption approaches.
•  Map current-state commerce operating models and identify where AI-enabled automation, intelligent decisioning, and real-time optimization can drive step-change improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.
•  Apply commerce domain knowledge to review and improve function-specific reinvention designs, capability frameworks, and commerce playbook content.
•  Support delivery of digital and platform solutions — including PIM, DAM, CMS, OMS, marketplace and retail media ecosystems — across client engagements.
Change Impact & Commerce Capability Analysis
•  Develop change-impact assessments for commerce transformation initiatives — documenting implications for roles, team structures, operating rhythms, governance, and capability requirements as AI is embedded into commerce workflows.
•  Contribute to the reference library and keep commerce domain expertise current through continuous learning and assigned development modules.
AX Design Application in Commerce
•  Apply AX Design principles when specifying or reviewing AI integration designs across commerce processes — defining how AI agents should behave within each step of the commerce lifecycle, what they handle autonomously (e.g., content variant generation, digital shelf monitoring, price and availability checks), and when they hand off to a human practitioner.
•  Ensure AX Design documentation is embedded within commerce process specifications and is consistent across all content, channel, and platform deliverables.
Professional & Technical Skills
•  1-4 years of experience in commerce transformation, digital commerce, process excellence, or management consulting with a commerce focus — with increasing independence across engagements.
•  Demonstrated experience producing commerce trend analyses, benchmarking outputs, capability assessments, or change-impact assessments for senior stakeholder review.
•  Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into commerce process design — including AI-driven content production, automated digital shelf management, intelligent pricing and assortment decisioning, and agent-assisted shopper journeys.
•  Familiarity with the commerce technology ecosystem: product information and asset management (PIM, DAM), content management, order management (OMS), marketplace and retail media platforms, and analytics tools.
•  Working understanding of AI-driven discovery and off-platform visibility — including AI-ready product content, structured product data and knowledge foundations, and visibility across answer engines and LLM surfaces.
•  Hands-on experience using AI-assisted analytics, visualization, or performance tools; comfortable synthesizing large data sets into clear commerce insights.
•  Ability to analyze complex commerce performance data and translate findings into structured, client-ready recommendations across process, channel mix, and operating model design.
•  Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce polished, senior-ready deliverables with limited direction.
•  Comfortable working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments with client-facing accountability.
Additional Information
•  Familiarity with process mapping or process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Signavio) applied to commerce workflows — content supply chain design, product onboarding flows, order-to-fulfilment mapping — is a strong differentiator.
•  Growing familiarity with AX Design concepts as applied to commerce — specifically how AI agent behaviours, autonomy levels, and handoff protocols are designed within content, digital shelf, merchandising, and channel execution workflows.
•  Client-facing consulting or advisory experience in commerce transformation, platform enablement, or digital commerce strategy; ability to build credibility with commerce and commercial leadership.
•  Experience with end-to-end commerce operations — from product onboarding and content enrichment through activation, merchandising, measurement, and optimization — is highly desirable.
•  Familiarity with data-driven commerce concepts: product data governance, assortment and pricing analytics, digital shelf measurement, and attribution across channels.
•  Proactive approach to continuous learning; stays current on AI developments reshaping commerce, including generative AI for content, AI-driven discovery, and agent-mediated purchasing.

With 774,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

title: Manager - FP&A
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance
As part of our EY - Finance Consulting Team, you will help clients develop their Performance Improvement initiatives and identify potential opportunities for performance improvements drive them. This includes techno-functional role conducting finance processes assessments, deep diving and analysing pain areas and coming up with solutions. The client base spans across industries and countries.
The opportunity
We’re looking for Manager with expertise in BPRA (Business Planning Reporting & Analytics), and BPRA Process Assessment assignments. Also, experience in, Financial Accounting and Reporting domain is an added advantage to join the global EY - Finance Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
Your Key Responsibilities
• Knowledge on Financial Planning and Budgeting Processes, Financial Consolidation, Cost Allocation and Controllership, EPM tools
• Focus on the design and implementation of operating models in BPRA
• Design, configuration and implementation of BPRA processes in EPM tools
• Lead forecasting and financial planning process (Budgeting and long-range financial plan) for the client/enterprise by analyzing the trends of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), especially relating to financial metrics such as sales, expenditures, profit margin etc.
• Transform the overarching company strategy into a long-range plan, annual budget, capital budgets and forecast
• Advice capital allocation plan, revenue plan, Opex/Capex plan, and key cost drivers to create / revise Income statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Forecasts
• Model how BPRA teams use information from multiple sources to model new assumptions, run sensitivity analysis and test alternatives, leverages analytical models and systematic projections (using in market expectations and other macro-trends) to identify updates required
• Review and explain key drivers, managing risks and opportunities, and updated forecast with Regional and Local leads, consolidating submissions and revisions from BUs, adjustments made as needed
• Provide regular/ad hoc strategic support to executive leadership (onshore/client) and provide support on current and future outlook, target setting outcome etc.
• Identify improvement opportunities in BPRA domain
• Process re-design and optimisation (AS-IS & TO-BE) leveraging BPM tools
• Identification of KPIs for CXO reporting and dashboarding
• Perform vendor analysis and prepare relevant analysis reports for clients
• Configuration and know how on activity-based costing models
• Partner directly with onshore finance teams/clients to collaborate on metrics, goals and business reviews
• Perform cost Accounting & cost categorization (People & Non people cost)
• Standardisation and streamline close processes leveraging leading practices and technology
• CoA design/re-design as per management and statutory reporting needs
• Build Management Reporting in tools like Power BI / Tableau / Qlik Sense / OneStream / Jedox / Anaplan / Hyperion / Board EPM
• Good Knowledge on ledger and sub-ledger systems; technical know-how of SAP ERP / HANA, Oracle GL (good to have)
• Knowledge in finance functions – ‘Record to report’, processes involving account reconciliations, Journals, Transaction matching, Variance analysis, intercompany and Fixed assets accounting / management (Good to have process knowledge of Procure to Pay and Order to Cash)
• Working knowledge of GBS / SSC setup engagements
• Should have knowledge of activities in financial close of an organisation for month / Quarter / Annual close periods
• Translate business requirements to technical language and model (good to have)
• Managing/ supervising teams of people on project work
• Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure
• Open to travel (Domestic & International)
Skills And Attributes For Success
• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, tasks and adapt to a changing environment
• Must be organized, focused, and driven to meet established deliverable deadlines
• Ability to lead client workshops and guide on BPRA vision and strategy
• Agile, Learnability and problem-solving approach
• Consulting experience is a must have
• Confident & professional communication style
• Proficiency in English (oral and written)
• Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences
• Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
• Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization
• Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others
• Strong analytical skills as well as excellent problem-solving skills for interpreting the IFRS standards
To qualify for the role, you must have
• CA, CFA, CPA, OR Master’s in business administration in Finance
• 10-15 years of work experience in BPRA projects
• Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
• Anaplan/Tagetik/Oracle PBCS and EPBCS/Power BI/Tableau/OneStream/Board and relevant EPM tools
Ideally, you’ll also have
• Finance Transformation
• GBS/SSC Setup
• Project management skills, IFRS Implementation / IFRS Reporting Experience
• Exposure to tools like ERP, EPM tools, Visio, ARIS, etc.
What We Look For
• A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
• Opportunities to work with EY Advisory practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What Working At EY Offers
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from world’s top companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
• The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

title: BC - SC and O - O and G Upstream Ops - Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Manager – Subsurface (O&G Upstream)
Desired Experience: 8–10 years
Mandatory Skill: 
• O&G Upstream Operations (Field / Production Operations domain depth)
Preferred Background:
• Experience with Integrated Oil Companies such as Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP
Role Purpose
Upstream Operations Subject Matter Expert (SME) embedded within a digital / AI use case delivery squad, acting as the functional bridge between upstream operations stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams (product, data science, data engineering, architecture). The role is non-coding and focuses on shaping, translating, validating, and governing upstream operations analytics / AI solutions to improve asset profitability, production efficiency, and recovery.
Operating Model & Reporting
• Workstream leadership role within an Agile / product-style delivery environment; responsible for end-to-end functional success of upstream operations use cases from discovery to deployment.
• Interfaces with upstream business teams and technical delivery teams (product managers, data scientists, data engineers, solution architects).
• Reports into Consulting Delivery Leadership and partners closely with MENA stakeholders on SC&O / Digital Ops priorities.
Key Responsibilities
• Upstream Operations Use Case Discovery & Functional Support
• Lead discovery sessions with upstream operations stakeholders to capture decision workflows, operational pain points, constraints, and success criteria
• Own the creation of structured documentation: use case descriptions, functional requirements, assumptions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder-ready narratives.
• Define and align upstream operations transformation roadmaps to improve asset profitability, production efficiency, and recovery.
• Digital / AI Use Case Delivery Support (Non-Coding)
• Translate upstream operations requirements into technical inputs for delivery teams (features, inputs, operational constraints, data definitions/classifications), ensuring feasibility and traceability.
• Support delivery of upstream operations digital solutions by helping define and validate data and workflow needs, including combining inputs from field planning, operations, and finance for performance optimization
• Validate analytics outputs, dashboards, and insights against operational realism and operating philosophies; drive iterative improvements with product/data teams.
• Stakeholder Management & Client-Facing Delivery
• Act as a trusted interface between upstream operations stakeholders and technical delivery teams; sustain credibility through practical workflow understanding.
• Lead structured feedback cycles (including pilots and phased rollouts) and convert feedback into clear requirements/backlog items.
• Lead cross-functional engagement and interviews across relevant upstream stakeholders as needed for platform delivery (e.g., field operations interfaces such as drilling/completions/facilities, HSE & emissions, finance/accounting, data infrastructure).
• Governance, Quality & Assurance
• Support definition of data quality standards, operational assumptions, and validation checkpoints for upstream operations datasets and model outputs.
• Ensure solutions align with established practices and contribute to documentation, playbooks, and governance artifacts for deployed use cases.
• Drive UAT planning and execution from a functional lens; confirm outputs are credible and usable for operations decision-making.
Required Experience & Qualifications
• 8–10 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong upstream operations / field operations depth.
• Practical experience articulating upstream operations workflows in practice, including operational constraints and data quality considerations.
• Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate operations concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams.
• Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning operations / engineering / digital teams in Agile delivery environments.
• Fluency in English (mandatory).
• Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines
• MBA
• Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models.
Preferred / Nice-to-Have
• Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts.
• Familiarity with upstream operations / production data sources and reporting environments used for operational performance tracking.
• Arabic language capability (optional).
EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Business unit specific description – Clients & Industries – GDS UKI
The Data Insights Executive serves as a strategic enabler of data-driven decision-making and digital transformation across UKI Client & Industries team. • Support digital transformation initiatives by leveraging Microsoft 365, Copilot, and automation to improve operational efficiency.

• Support leadership decision-making through timely and accurate reporting, trend analysis, and actionable insights.
• Design, develop, and maintain business applications using PowerApps (Canvas) to support operational and business requirements.
• Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel Online, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
• Collaborate closely with MSM, BD, BMC, FMT, Operations, and other relevant teams to develop effective and user-centric solutions.
• Support user adoption through training, documentation, knowledge sharing, and ongoing assistance.
• Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and Alteryx-based ETL workflows to strengthen data-driven reporting and decision-making
Skills And Attributes For Success
• Demonstrates good proficiency in analytics platforms and visualisation tools such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar tools to transform data into meaningful and actionable insights.
• Skilled in developing interactive dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders understand trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
• Applies analytical and basic statistical techniques to support business decision-making and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Good project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deliverables effectively.
• Presentation and facilitation skills: Ability to participate in and facilitate meetings, develop presentations, interpret data, generate meaningful business insights, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.
• Ownership and accountability: Ability to work independently with appropriate guidance, take ownership of assigned tasks and projects, and ensure timely delivery.
• Business acumen and adaptability: Ability to understand business requirements and adapt to changing stakeholder and customer expectations.
• Quick learner: Ability to quickly understand processes, project objectives, requirements, and complexities and move into delivery effectively.
• Process improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce turnaround times, enhance quality, and generate additional insights.
• Attention to detail: Maintain accuracy and consistency across data, numbers, analysis, reporting, and formatting.
• Multi-tasking capability: Demonstrate effective time management, prioritization, and the ability to manage multiple deliverables.
• Excellent communication: Strong listening, reading, writing, and verbal communication skills.
• Experience working with business stakeholders and senior team members, with the ability to understand requirements and communicate effectively.
• MS Office skills: Good to advanced proficiency in Excel reporting and PowerPoint presentations.
• Power BI / Other BI tools / Alteryx: Hands-on experience in data integration, data preparation, reporting, and data visualization.
• Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism, integrity, accountability, and collaboration.
To qualify for the role, you must have
• Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 3 - 6 years’ work experience in professional services industry having exposure working on applications and automation.
• Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
What We Look For
• Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
• Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
• Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.

• Master of Business Administration

•  Identify and prioritize high-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways. 
•  Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility. 
•  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post-launch iteration. 
•  Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths. 
•  Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade-offs and decisions to client stakeholders. 
•  Support clients in shaping AI-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go-to-market considerations. 
•  Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision-making. 
•  Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach. 
•  Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.

 Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy) 
•  – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities. 
•  – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation. 
•  – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions. 
•  - Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models 
•  – Experience owning AI-powered features end-to-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.

 Position Summary 
 Artificial Intelligence & Engineering 
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
Position Summary
 Role:  Strategy, Growth, and Transformation III

description:
Summary
 Position Summary 
 Strategy & Transactions - Mergers & Acquisition – SD – Senior Consultant 
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
Position Summary
 Level:  Senior Consultant or equivalent
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
 Work you’ll do: 
We guide M&A initiatives for companies to help identify and realize revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model or capital model. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
•  1. Develop client deliverables and documentation: 
•  Identify and select the most relevant set of tools/techniques to meet client requirements such as business case development, financial modeling, and analysis, etc.
•  Analyze and interpret project data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations based on the result of the specific outputs.
•  Use analytics to build strategic insights for the client.
•  Define project standards, methodologies, and execute process improvement initiatives.
•  2. Engage in client interaction: 
•  Conduct client interviews to verify and validate assumptions, hypothesis, and analysis.
•  Participate in workshops and training sessions.
•  Synthesize and present insights and recommendations.
•  Develop and maintain working relationships with client counterparts.
•  3. Participate in engagement management including: 
•  Own and manage specific work threads.
•  Develop plans for components of engagements.
•  Coordinate activities between different work threads.
•  Identify and help manage changes in scope.
•  Manage and mentor junior resources.
 The Team: 
The M&A team bring deep industry experience, rigorous analytical capabilities and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients' most complex business problems. Our operational capabilities address the unique issues faced by manufacturing organizations, service businesses and infrastructure operations. These are combined with capabilities in finance, performance management and business restructuring. Our teams take the lead on delivering all aspects of the people side of transactions to our clients. We leverage commercial awareness and professional expertise, along with using the skills and expertise of others, to deliver the best possible experience and outcomes
Capabilities of an M&A practitioner will include the following:
•  Developing an M&A strategy 
•  Providing buy-side and sell-side advisory support, screening targets and undertaking due diligence 
•  Optimizing the operating model and organization design 
•  Targeting synergies, developing a roadmap to help realize those synergies and measuring synergies 
•  Preparing for Day-One/ Day-Two readiness and executing the plan 
•  Developing communications for culture and change management 
•  Integrating supply chains, distribution networks, R&D, finance, procurement, real estate and innovation 
•  Aligning customers, sales, marketing and back-offices 
•  Developing carve-out financial statements 
•  Formulating organizational separation and re-alignment strategies 
•  Optimizing transition services agreement (TSA) 
•  Identifying and eliminating stranded costs 
Qualifications
 Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
•  MBA is mandatory. Engineering undergrads are preferred but not mandatory 
•  3- 5 years of relevant experience for Senior Consultants 
 Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
•  Consulting Background 
•  M&A advisory experience 
•  Commercial/ Operational due diligence experience 
•  Prior investment banking experience on the sell/ buy side 
•  Specific functional knowledge in areas of Finance, IT, Contracts management, procurement etc 
•  Demonstrated experience in financial statement and operations analytics 
 Education:  MBA is mandatory. Engineering undergrad is preferred but not mandatory
 Location:  Bengaluru /Hyderabad /Pune

Summary
 Position Summary 
 Job Description – AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy (Sr. Consultant)  At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth  Within S&T, the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure strategy capability plays a critical role in shaping how organizations modernize their core technology foundations to enable digital, cloud, and AI-led transformation. As a Strategy professional in this space, you will help clients define their enterprise-wide AI and hybrid infrastructure strategy, help them make sense of their AI consumption economics, identify value creation and cost optimization opportunities, and design future-ready operating models that bridge business ambition with technical reality.  But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. You’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.  If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy is your next move. 
 The Team 
The AI and Hybrid Infrastructure team sits at the core of Deloitte’s technology-enabled transformation agenda. We advise clients on where and how to modernize their infrastructure landscape — spanning data centers, hybrid and multi-cloud platforms, networks, and AI-enabled infrastructure — to support business growth, resilience, and innovation.
Our work is strategy-led and outcome-oriented, focused on helping executives make clear, data-driven decisions on topics such as:
•  AI Infrastructure strategy
•  AI Economics / Tokenomics strategy
•  Hybrid Cloud strategy
•  Enterprise Infrastructure and platform enablement
•  Legacy modernization and technical debt reduction
•  Cost optimization, resilience, and scalability
•  Technology operating model and governance design
•  AI / Hybrid Cloud sourcing strategies
Strategy professionals in this team act as trusted advisors to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business leaders, translating complex business problems into actionable technology choices. We are looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who combine strong analytical thinking with a solid understanding of modern infrastructure and AI ecosystems.
 Work You Will Do 
As part of the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy team, you will work with clients to shape and execute their AI infrastructure and platform strategies across hybrid environments (Cloud. On-premise, Edge) ensuring alignment with broader business and digital transformation goals.
Your responsibilities will include supporting enterprise infrastructure and AI platform strategies (including hybrid and multi-cloud adoption roadmaps, investment prioritization, and value realization cases), advising clients on high-level AI-ready infrastructure architectures, designing target-state technology operating models, compute and token consumption strategies, including trade-offs between cost, performance, scalability and conducting strategic assessment and diagnostics across infrastructure, AI platforms and MLOps. This role provides exposure to complex, high-visibility transformation programs and enables you to build deep expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and enterprise infrastructure in a client-facing consulting environment.
Required Experience And Skills
•  Ability to translate complex infrastructure and AI architecture concepts into clear business value narratives for executive and non-technical stakeholders
•  Strong understanding of how infrastructure, cloud, data and AI investments drive growth, cost efficiency, risk reduction, and operational resilience
•  Ability to articulate emerging trends, best practices, and strategic implications of AI infrastructure and hybrid cloud adoption across industries
•  Infrastructure, Cloud and AI domain knowledge:
•  Foundational understanding of enterprise infrastructure concepts, including compute, storage, networking, and hybrid / multi-cloud architectures
•  Understanding of AI/ML lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, inference) and concepts such as tokens, RAG, LLMs, Vector Databases etc.
•  Understanding of cost drivers in AI and infrastructure (e.g., compute, storage, token usage, cloud consumption models) and ability to support cost-benefit analysis and TCO evaluations
•  Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, platforms, frameworks, ecosystems (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, NVIDIA AI platforms) and their infrastructure implications
•  Understanding of key compliance, security, and regulatory standards relevant to Infrastructure and AI environments (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF)
•  Architecture & Transformation Experience: Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience in either one or more of the following areas:
•  AI or cloud infrastructure strategy, architecture, or large-scale transformation initiatives
•  Design or assessment of AI/ML platforms, MLOps workflows, or AI-ready infrastructure environments
•  Infrastructure modernization, cost optimization, or operating model transformation programs
•  AI Economics and optimization
•  Exposure to integrating compute, networking, and storage capabilities to support scalable AI or cloud workloads, with an emphasis on architectural decision-making rather than hands-on operations
•  Experience supporting ecosystem-driven solutions and working with technology partners to shape solution options and recommendations
•  Ability to support benchmarking, performance assessments, and business case development to inform infrastructure and AI investment decisions
•  Experience defining target operating models (TOMs), roadmaps, governance frameworks, and process designs
•  Exposure to security, governance, and compliance considerations across infrastructure and AI stacks
•  Interest in contributing to internal knowledge development, POVs, or client thought leadership as part of broader practice growth
•  Exposure to working with non-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders
Core Consulting Skills
•  Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
•  Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
•  Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data
•  Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
•  Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
•  Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
•  Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization
Qualifications
•  Bachelor’s degree in a relevant STEM Field (ex. Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics) from a premier school in India or abroad
•  MBA, MS, M. Tech. from a premier school in India or abroad, with a background in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, etc.
•  4+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in in roles involving technology strategy, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, or large-scale infrastructure and cloud initiatives
•  Relevant certifications in hybrid cloud/AI infrastructure space would be nice to have (e.g., TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CISM, CISSP, CEH)

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-M&A-Senior Consultant-SD
description:
Summary
 Position Summary 
 Strategy & Transactions - Mergers & Acquisition – SD – Senior Consultant 
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
Position Summary
 Level:  Senior Consultant or equivalent
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
 Work you’ll do: 
We guide M&A initiatives for companies to help identify and realize revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model or capital model. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
•  1. Develop client deliverables and documentation: 
•  Identify and select the most relevant set of tools/techniques to meet client requirements such as business case development, financial modeling, and analysis, etc.
•  Analyze and interpret project data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations based on the result of the specific outputs.
•  Use analytics to build strategic insights for the client.
•  Define project standards, methodologies, and execute process improvement initiatives.
•  2. Engage in client interaction: 
•  Conduct client interviews to verify and validate assumptions, hypothesis, and analysis.
•  Participate in workshops and training sessions.
•  Synthesize and present insights and recommendations.
•  Develop and maintain working relationships with client counterparts.
•  3. Participate in engagement management including: 
•  Own and manage specific work threads.
•  Develop plans for components of engagements.
•  Coordinate activities between different work threads.
•  Identify and help manage changes in scope.
•  Manage and mentor junior resources.
 The Team: 
The M&A team bring deep industry experience, rigorous analytical capabilities and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients' most complex business problems. Our operational capabilities address the unique issues faced by manufacturing organizations, service businesses and infrastructure operations. These are combined with capabilities in finance, performance management and business restructuring. Our teams take the lead on delivering all aspects of the people side of transactions to our clients. We leverage commercial awareness and professional expertise, along with using the skills and expertise of others, to deliver the best possible experience and outcomes
Capabilities of an M&A practitioner will include the following:
•  Developing an M&A strategy 
•  Providing buy-side and sell-side advisory support, screening targets and undertaking due diligence 
•  Optimizing the operating model and organization design 
•  Targeting synergies, developing a roadmap to help realize those synergies and measuring synergies 
•  Preparing for Day-One/ Day-Two readiness and executing the plan 
•  Developing communications for culture and change management 
•  Integrating supply chains, distribution networks, R&D, finance, procurement, real estate and innovation 
•  Aligning customers, sales, marketing and back-offices 
•  Developing carve-out financial statements 
•  Formulating organizational separation and re-alignment strategies 
•  Optimizing transition services agreement (TSA) 
•  Identifying and eliminating stranded costs 
Qualifications
 Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
•  MBA is mandatory. Engineering undergrads are preferred but not mandatory 
•  3- 5 years of relevant experience for Senior Consultants 
 Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
•  Consulting Background 
•  M&A advisory experience 
•  Commercial/ Operational due diligence experience 
•  Prior investment banking experience on the sell/ buy side 
•  Specific functional knowledge in areas of Finance, IT, Contracts management, procurement etc 
•  Demonstrated experience in financial statement and operations analytics 
 Education:  MBA is mandatory. Engineering undergrad is preferred but not mandatory
 Location:  Bengaluru /Hyderabad /Pune

title: Associate - Deals Advisory - Deals Strategy
description:
Job Overview
This position is for an Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.
Strategy& (S&) is our global strategy consulting business. It is a specialist team within PwC that combines strategy consulting capabilities with leading industry and sector insights and know-how. The team helps clients identify and build the capabilities essential to their advantage, and develop strategies based on these capabilities.
S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology, Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma).
The Deals channel is the largest channel for our UK team. Our work shapes the M&A landscape by supporting private equity (PE) and corporate clients in developing investment perspectives and value creation strategies that make a difference in the highly competitive M&A market.
We serve PE clients with over £2.5 trillion in assets under management, and publicly traded companies with a combined market capitalisation of over £4 trillion. From initial investment strategy development to commercial due diligence, value creation post-close and exit, we’re here to help our clients drive growth.
The S& Acceleration Centre in India is a specialist team within our broader PwC Kolkata Acceleration Centre that plays a critical role working with the UK team in project preparation and executing, including all responsibilities typically required of a UK-based team member from Experienced Associate to Manager. This includes analysis, research, output creation, presentation and discussion.
Responsibilities Include
• Work in a team setting on delivery modules such as market analysis (sizing, forecasting, etc.), competitive analysis (benchmarking, differentiation, landscape analysis), business plan analysis, customer and financial analysis, survey analysis, website scraping, industry research, etc.
• Conduct rigorous analysis in Microsoft Excel, and produce client-ready output in Microsoft PowerPoint
• Ability to build solid and collaborative relationships with team members
• Proactively assist the team in various aspects of the client engagement
• Contribute to the development of your own and team’s technical and functional acumen
• Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct
Other Areas
• Contribute to practice enablement and business development activities
• Learning new tools and technologies including generative AI (genAI) as required
• Develop/implement automation solutions and capabilities that are aligned to clients’ business requirements
• Develop internal relationships to build trust in an effort to develop and market the KAC brand
• Keep up to date with local and global business and economic issues
• Staying in the loop and on top of the latest M&A trends
Desired Experience And Skills
• 2 to 3 years of industry experience
• Relevant experience in private equity, commercial due diligence, target screening and / or M&A advisory is an asset
• Ability to understand, contextualise, and solve commercial problems through independent analysis and research
• Ability to work as an integrated team member with the UK team in delivering client work
• Effective written and excellent verbal business communication skills when interacting with team members and/or clients in a professional setting
• Multi-tasking and balancing time effectively, keeping a rapid pace without sacrificing quality
• Relevant experience in conducting primary research (including desktop research, surveys and web scraping) and secondary research is an asset
• Relevant experience in analysis of complex data (e.g. survey outputs, financial statements, business plans) is an asset
• Relevant experience in creating client-ready deliverables including PowerPoint slides and reports is an asset
• Experience in using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint is required, and experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI and other similar tools is an asset
Desired Soft Skills
• Strong work ethic, proactive and professional behaviour
• Strategic and creative thinker, problem solver
Educational Background
• MBA from premier B-Schools (preferred)
• Strong academic credentials, analytical ability and leadership skills
Additional Information
• Time type: Full time
• Work timings: Work hours may vary for specific projects
• Travel requirements: None
• Past experience: Past experience in consulting and exposure to a multinational environment will be an added bonus.

title: Senior Associate - Deals Advisory - Deals Strategy
description:
Job Description
Job Overview:
This position is for a Senior Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.
Strategy& (S&) is our global strategy consulting business. It is a specialist team within PwC that combines strategy consulting capabilities with leading industry and sector insights and know-how. The team helps clients identify and build the capabilities essential to their advantage, and develop strategies based on these capabilities.
S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology, Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma).
The Deals channel is the largest channel for our UK team. Our work shapes the M&A landscape by supporting private equity (PE) and corporate clients in developing investment perspectives and value creation strategies that make a difference in the highly competitive M&A market.
We serve PE clients with over £2.5 trillion in assets under management, and publicly traded companies with a combined market capitalisation of over £4 trillion. From initial investment strategy development to commercial due diligence, value creation post-close and exit, we’re here to help our clients drive growth.
The S& Acceleration Centre in India is a specialist team within our broader PwC Kolkata Acceleration Centre that plays a critical role working with the UK team in project preparation and executing, including all responsibilities typically required of a UK-based team member from Experienced Associate to Manager. This includes analysis, research, output creation, presentation and discussion.
Responsibilities Include
• Help create and review delivery modules such as market analysis (sizing, forecasting, etc.), competitive analysis (benchmarking, differentiation, landscape analysis), business plan analysis, customer and financial analysis, survey analysis, website scraping, industry research, and more
• Conduct rigorous analysis in Microsoft Excel, and produce client-ready output in Microsoft PowerPoint
• Drive day-to-day deliverables within the Project team by helping in work-planning, problem solving, hypotheses generation and research tools, including reviewing your work and that of others for quality, accuracy, and relevance
• Work closely with the UK S& team to fully support client engagements
• Assist with KAC team onboarding and training programmes
• Contribute to the development of your own and team’s technical and functional acumen
• Demonstrate critical thinking, an ability to bring order to unstructured problems, and excellent commercial acumen
• Delegate to others to provide stretch opportunities, coaching them to deliver results
• Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct
Other Areas
• Contribute to practice enablement and business development activities (proposal responses, client interactions, workshop preparation, etc.)
• Learning new tools and technologies including generative AI (genAI) as required
• Develop/implement automation solutions and capabilities that are aligned to clients’ business requirements
• Know how and when to use tools available for a given situation and explain reasons for this choice
• Develop internal relationships to build trust in an effort to develop and market the KAC brand
• Keep up to date with local and global business and economic issues
• Use feedback and reflection to develop self-awareness, personal strengths and address development areas
• Use straightforward communication, in a structured way, when influencing and connecting with others
• Provide others with examples of prior problem solving to help guide team members
• Staying in the loop and on top of the latest M&A trends
Desired Experience And Skills
• 4 to 7 years of industry experience with an emphasis on consulting services and project delivery
• Relevant experience in private equity, commercial due diligence, target screening and / or M&A advisory is an asset
• Ability to understand, contextualise, and solve commercial problems through independent analysis and research
• Ability to work as an integrated team member with the UK team in delivering client work, and to effectively take ownership and work on projects under stringent timelines while working both independently and in a team environment
• Effective written and excellent verbal business communication skills when interacting with team members and/or clients in a professional setting
• Ability to utilise project management skills to time-manage tasks
• Experience in creating clear and concise reports, including graphics and data visualisation and commentary for clients, and clearly presenting findings to others
• Relevant experience in conducting primary research (including desktop research, surveys and web scraping) and secondary research required
• Relevant experience in analysis of complex data (e.g. survey outputs, financial statements, business plans) required
• Relevant experience in creating client-ready deliverables including PowerPoint slides and reports required
• Experience in using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint is required, and experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI and other similar tools is an asset
• Multi-tasking and balancing time effectively, keeping a rapid pace without sacrificing quality
Desired Soft Skills
• Strong work ethic, proactive and professional behaviour
• Strategic and creative thinker, problem solver
Educational Background
• MBA from premier B-Schools (preferred)
• Strong academic credentials, analytical ability and leadership skills

• Time type: Full time
• Work timings: Work hours may vary for specific projects
• Travel requirements: None

description:
Job Description
#KGS
As one of fastest growing practice in DAS, Infrastructure and Climate Advisory (ICA) team at KGS invites like-minded professionals to help us drive progress and change. At KGS ICA practice, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team across a range of industries to assist public and private sector organizations involved in infrastructure to deliver desired outcomes, whether for society or for businesses. We are the Centre of Excellence for KPMG’s Global practices, helping our clients better understand evolving policy and regulatory environment, business and commercial risks, as well as providing commercial and strategic advice on complex infrastructure and capital projects. You will work on wide range of infrastructure sectors including transport, energy, digital infrastructure as well as social infrastructure, with diverse clientage such as public sector entities, infrastructure owners, project developers, large corporates, contractors, equity investors and financers.
The role will be based out of KPMG’s Gurugram office and liaise cross-functionally with leaders across the business to drive internal and external engagement.
Responsibilities
• Support senior members in engagements through out the life cycle of Infrastructure projects (strategy, development, and performance) for clients in the government & public sector, corporates, institutional investors and infrastructure developers
• Conceptualize & develop reports on topics such as organizational policies, market assessment, market sizing, business plans, feasibility studies, business case evaluations and capital investment plans
• Contribute to thought leadership, white papers and point of views to develop market intelligence and sector knowledge
• Support Global Infrastructure advisory teams on business development initiatives, including preparation of proposals, pitches
• Conduct research, synthesize insights and develop presentations for end client deliverables
• Manage relationships with key stakeholders independently across various member firms
Qualifications
Educational qualifications
• Post-graduates/MBAs from a leading Indian/International educational institution
• Candidates holding professional certification relevant to the requirements are preferred, but not mandatory.
Work Experience
• Relevant experience (1-3 years) in strategy gained through corporate roles, consulting, or public sector organizations
Mandatory Technical & Functional Skills
• Exposure to and working experience in any Infrastructure sector (Transport, Oil & Gas, Broadband, Real Estate or Utilities etc.) sector is mandatory
• Understanding of the infrastructure asset lifecycle and how it impacts strategy and operations within various sectors
• Experience in strategic planning and operational frameworks to assess market trends, identify opportunities, and develop strategies to optimize project outcomes
• Strong analytical capabilities including to be able to conduct data analysis, risk assessments, market studies and provide recommendations for improvements
• Be proficient in Microsoft office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and in making presentations for senior level stakeholders with effective story boarding skills
• Having familiarity with data analysis tools like Alteryx, visualization tools like Power BI, Visio. Moreover, experience of application of Gen AI based tools would be an advantage

title: Senior Consultant - Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
Your impact
Jacobs are seeking a Senior Consultant to join our Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory team to support high-impact transport and mobility advisory projects across the region. If you are passionate about rethinking mobility, advising clients, and solving complex urban transport challenges through delivery transformation and innovation, this role offers an exciting platform to accelerate your career.
As a Senior Consultant, you will support the delivery of multidisciplinary transport and mobility advisory services, working alongside project leaders and cross-functional teams. Your responsibilities will include
• Supporting the delivery of strategic transport and mobility advisory project, including urban mobility strategies, public transport policy, EV/AV deployment plans, freight and logistics advisory, and transport-related feasibility studies.
• Supporting project tasks, developing client-ready outputs, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Supporting the development of policy frameworks, business cases, and implementation plans for public and private sectors.
• Conducting research and analysis on emerging mobility trends and technologies (e.g. smart mobility, MaaS, low-carbon transport, ITS)
• Support the management of stakeholder consultation activities and preparing reports, presentations, and briefing materials for high-level government and private clients.
Here's what you'll need
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in transport planning, urban planning, economics, engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in transport or mobility consulting, with exposure to strategic advisory projects.
• Ability to work across a variety of transport topics, such as urban mobility, integrated transport planning, policy development or freight and logistics.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Proficiency in developing high-quality reports, presentations and strategic insights for clients.
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

description:

As a member of KDN, you’ll be a part of the KPMG family working alongside some of our profession’s most skilled practitioners on rewarding programs and initiatives that are changing the way business operates, delivering value to our clients, and driving positive change in the communities we serve.
You’ll be enabling KDN accelerate new ways of working, using cutting-edge technology and working together with our member firms located in nearly 150 countries to help us achieve our ambition to be the most trusted and trustworthy professional services firm. title: I&P-GN-SC&E-Senior Manager - VCR - Connected Twins
description:
Find endless opportunities to solve our clients' toughest challenges, as you work with exceptional people, the latest tech, and leading companies across industries. 
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network I Areas of Work: Digital Thread and Connected Twins | Level: Manager | Location: Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad | Overall Relevant Exp: 7+ years 
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making.
Digital Thread
Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making.
• Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems. 
• Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration. 
• Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain. 
Connected Twins
Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
• Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains. 
• Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment. 
• Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders. 
Key Responsibilities
• Lead Digital Thread and Connected Twin transformation programs from strategy through execution across product development, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions 
• Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps and investment strategies for clients seeking to improve traceability, visibility, operational resilience and decision intelligence 
• Shape Digital Thread strategies across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, APS and supply chain ecosystems to improve product lifecycle visibility and concept-to-service integration 
• Define Connected Twin strategies and use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, logistics networks, facilities and end-to-end supply chains 
• Lead executive workshops and client discussions focused on value realization, operating model transformation, AI readiness, simulation capabilities and supply chain resilience 
• Drive process architecture, future-state operating models and enterprise decision-support frameworks enabled by Digital Thread, Connected Twins and GenAI 
• Lead scenario simulation initiatives involving network optimization, disruption analysis, inventory strategies, manufacturing performance, quality improvement and supply chain risk assessment 
• Define GenAI-enabled decision intelligence capabilities, agentic workflows and AI copilots that support operational planning and business decision making 
• Contribute to pre-sales activities including opportunity qualification, client presentations, solution development, proposal creation and business case development 
• Develop industry-specific offerings, consulting methodologies, reusable assets, accelerators and thought leadership related to Digital Thread and Connected Twins 
• Partner with Industry X, Data & AI, Supply Chain, Engineering and Technology teams to develop integrated client solutions 
• Build and mentor high-performing consulting teams while supporting capability development, knowledge management and career growth
