• Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains. 
• Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment. 
• Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders. 
Key Responsibilities
• Lead Digital Thread and Connected Twin transformation programs from strategy through execution across product development, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions 
• Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps and investment strategies for clients seeking to improve traceability, visibility, operational resilience and decision intelligence 
• Shape Digital Thread strategies across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, APS and supply chain ecosystems to improve product lifecycle visibility and concept-to-service integration 
• Define Connected Twin strategies and use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, logistics networks, facilities and end-to-end supply chains 
• Lead executive workshops and client discussions focused on value realization, operating model transformation, AI readiness, simulation capabilities and supply chain resilience 
• Drive process architecture, future-state operating models and enterprise decision-support frameworks enabled by Digital Thread, Connected Twins and GenAI 
• Lead scenario simulation initiatives involving network optimization, disruption analysis, inventory strategies, manufacturing performance, quality improvement and supply chain risk assessment 
• Define GenAI-enabled decision intelligence capabilities, agentic workflows and AI copilots that support operational planning and business decision making 
• Contribute to pre-sales activities including opportunity qualification, client presentations, solution development, proposal creation and business case development 
• Develop industry-specific offerings, consulting methodologies, reusable assets, accelerators and thought leadership related to Digital Thread and Connected Twins 
• Partner with Industry X, Data & AI, Supply Chain, Engineering and Technology teams to develop integrated client solutions 
• Build and mentor high-performing consulting teams while supporting capability development, knowledge management and career growth

title: BC sector-TMT-Partner
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
JOB DESCRIPTION-Strategic Transformation Partner
Objective and purpose:
There is a strategic mandate to strengthen EY's Media & Entertainment sector leadership within GDS through the expansion of the Strategic Transformation Partner (STP) programme. This leader will serve as the sector leader for Media & Entertainment, driving market development, executive relationships, industry thought leadership, and large-scale transformation pursuits across Streaming & OTT platforms, Broadcasters, Publishers, Gaming organisations, Sports & Entertainment businesses, and Digital Media companies. The role will be accountable for originating and delivering complex transformation programmes spanning Growth, Content Monetisation, Audience and Subscriber Growth, Revenue and Advertising Operations, Operating Model Transformation, Cost Optimisation, Shared Services/GCC Strategy, Commercial Effectiveness, and Business Performance Improvement.
Scope of the position:
• Build and lead EY's Media & Entertainment market presence by originating strategic transformation programmes across major broadcasters, streaming platforms, publishers, gaming organisations, sports leagues, entertainment companies, and digital media businesses.
• Advise executive leadership teams on strategic growth priorities including audience acquisition and retention, subscriber economics, content portfolio optimisation, advertising monetisation, rights and royalties management, operating model effectiveness, and business performance improvement.
• Drive industry-led growth by developing executive relationships, shaping complex pursuits, creating market-leading thought leadership, fostering ecosystem partnerships, and positioning EY as a trusted transformation advisor within the global Media & Entertainment sector.
Essential Functions Of The Job (Enter The Description)
• Lead large, complex Media & Entertainment transformation pursuits across broadcasters, streaming platforms, publishers, gaming companies, sports organizations, advertising businesses, and digital media companies, driving growth, operating model transformation, commercial effectiveness, and enterprise-wide performance improvement.
• Design and deliver strategic transformation programmes spanning audience and subscriber growth, content monetization, rights and royalties management, content supply chain optimization, advertising operations, customer experience enhancement, organizational transformation, and shared services/GCC strategy.
• Build and maintain trusted relationships with CEOs, Chief Content Officers, Chief Revenue Officers, Chief Digital Officers, Chief Marketing Officers, studio leadership teams, and business executives, positioning EY as the preferred advisor for industry transformation and growth.
• Lead cost transformation and profitability improvement programmes covering content operations, production and post-production workflows, rights and royalties management, media supply chains, streaming and platform operations, advertising operations, audience engagement, and global operating model design.
• Oversee the development and commercialization of Media & Entertainment sector assets, benchmarks, and industry solutions, including streaming economics frameworks, content profitability benchmarks, audience growth models, advertising monetization frameworks, rights management solutions, and operating model accelerators.
• Shape and articulate compelling, value-differentiated proposals that integrate capabilities across strategy, operations, finance, workforce transformation, customer experience, risk, and organizational change to address client priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Drive integrated go-to-market initiatives across Consulting, Strategy and Transactions, Tax, and Assurance, establishing EY as a leading advisor within the Media & Entertainment sector through industry thought leadership, executive engagement, strategic alliances, and sector-led growth initiatives.
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities (Enter The Description)
• Exercise strategic judgment in evaluating pursuit opportunities, including deal qualification, win probability assessment, competitive positioning, and required investment levels to secure large, complex transformation engagements.

• Direct the development of pricing, commercial models, and deal shaping strategies for major pursuits, balancing risk, margin, delivery feasibility, regulatory constraints, and client value considerations.
• Analyze client industry trends, competitive dynamics, and financial performance to inform account strategy, go to market priorities, and investment in sector specific assets or accelerators
• Make decisions on solution architecture involving GenAI, cloud platforms, data engineering, analytics, and automation, grounded in technical, financial, and operational analysis.

• Advanced degree preferred (MBA, MS in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering)

• Deep expertise in the Media & Entertainment industry, including streaming and OTT platforms, broadcasting, publishing, gaming, sports and entertainment, advertising, digital media, and evolving sector business models.

• Proven experience leading complex enterprise transformation programmes, driving measurable business outcomes, managing senior stakeholder expectations, and delivering sustainable value realisation.
Good to have (Differentiators)
• Recognised industry thought leader with established relationships across Media & Entertainment organisations, industry bodies, strategic alliances, and ecosystem partners.
• Experience advising broadcasters, streaming platforms, publishers, gaming companies, sports organisations, advertising businesses, or digital media companies on strategic growth and transformation initiatives.

title: Consultant HR M&A
description:
Job Description
#KGS
KPMG Global Services (KGS) was set up in India in 2008. It is a strategic global delivery organization, which works with more than 50 KPMG member firms to provide a progressive, scalable and customized approach to business requirements
The KGS journey has been one of consistent growth, with a current employee count of nearly 10,000 operating from four locations in India — Bengaluru, Gurugram, Kochi, Pune and Mumbai providing a range of Advisory and Tax-related services to member firms within the KPMG network.
As part of KPMG in India, we were ranked among the top companies to work for in the country for four years in a row by LinkedIn, and recognized as one of the top three employers in the region for women, as well as for policies on Inclusion & Diversity by ASSOCHAM (The Associated Chambers of Commerce & Industry of India).
Team Overview
The position in discussion is with Integration & Separation (I&S), Technology in M&A within the Deal Advisory group at KPMG Global Services (KGS), which is KPMG’s global delivery center and an integral part of the firm’s strategy to enhance innovation, build scalability, and improve profitability globally.
• KGS DA&S has been providing solutions to KPMG member firms globally. By leveraging insights and applying best practices, the team helps create customized approaches to M&A transactions. The team’s capabilities include Corporate Finance, Transaction Services, Strategy, Business Modelling, Accounting Advisory Services, Deal Advisory Research and Benchmarking.
• KPMG’s Integration & Separation team (ISA) advises clients on executing the operational integrations of acquisitions or joint ventures, and separations of businesses, in the case of divestitures or sale. I&S does this by taking an enterprise‑wide view of M&A deals, across all the functions, to deliver value to our clients. In addition, team is also involved in pre-deal Due Diligence on specific areas of business.
Responsibilities
We are recruiting for Consultant in the HR M&A team.
Roles & responsibilities
• Working with onshore colleagues to lead and provide support on a wide variety of M&A projects including global programs from a people, workforce analytics and organization effectiveness perspective
• Support and sometimes lead work streams on HR I&S projects, supporting client work stream leads to fulfil their work stream objectives
• Work with project teams to analyze workforce data by applying key analytical tools to provide key insights and suggest solutions to solve complex client challenges
• Demonstrate technical and analytical competence in a deal context for key HR aspects: HR Operations, Labor Relations & Compliance, Organization & Talent Management and Employee Experience and Day 1 comms
• Proactively co-ordinate with onshore engagement teams to procure new engagements / engagement work, obtain clarifications, communicate progress and post-delivery de-brief and feedback
• Seek ownership for independent engagement and tasks and on larger engagements oversee the work of more junior team members
• Assist in the development and presentation of final project deliverables
• Provide coaching and development opportunities for junior team members, and act as a mentor to colleagues within the team
• Work with cross-functional teams in implementing services, lead team interviews and hold workshops as necessary
• When you are not working on a project, you will provide support to senior colleagues in preparation of proposal materials
Qualifications
This role is for you if you have the below
Educational Qualifications
• MBA / Bachelor’s degree in a related field from an accredited college/university preferably with major in Human resources
Work Experience
• 3-5 years of total work experience
Mandatory Technical & Functional Skills
• Experience of working on M&A projects including an understanding of HR’s involvement in the deal process is desirable
• Experience of working with Powered BI, Alteryx, Tableau
• Relevant professional experience, including previous work with a Big 4, global management consultancy firm, or performed an in-house role in which you gained exposure to a large-scale project(s)
• Experience working within an HR function including workforce analytics, organization effectiveness, people strategy, organizational design, HR operating model, HR Process efficiency & policy, change management, employee engagement, talent management (Not all specialisms are required and a deep understanding in one area may be sufficient)
• Experience of handling multiple stakeholders including ownership of deliverables and good commercial acumen
• High quality outputs on Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Knowledge or experience on Visio, OrgVue would also be beneficial 
Preferred Technical & Functional Skills
• Analysis, problem solving and Report writing
• A basic understanding of project management methodologies and outputs 
• Good client relationship skills

Join EY and shape your future with confidence.
The opportunity
The Strategy & Execution team in EY-Parthenon recognizes that CEOs and business leaders are tasked with achieving maximum value for their organizations’ stakeholders in a transformative business environment. We challenge assumptions to design and deliver strategies that improve profitability, strengthen competitiveness and create long-term value.
We are looking for an experienced strategy consulting professional to join EY-Parthenon GDS India as an Associate Director within the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
You will be based in EY GDS India and work as an integrated member of the Singapore Strategy & Execution team, primarily supporting client engagements across Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
This is a client-facing consulting and leadership role. You will work closely with EY-Parthenon teams and clients across ASEAN to develop and deliver strategic opportunities, drawing on market, competitor and customer insights and incorporating commercial, operational, financial and implementation perspectives.
The role provides the opportunity to work on complex, cross-border engagements, develop relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to building EY-Parthenon’s Consumer Products and Retail capabilities across Singapore, ASEAN and GDS India.
Your Key Responsibilities
Client engagement and delivery
• Lead client engagements, major workstreams or independent modules across strategy, commercial transformation and operational transformation assignments.
• Structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses and define robust approaches to address clients’ strategic and operational priorities.
• Lead the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative information, translate findings into insights and formulate practical recommendations.
• Take ownership of the quality, timeliness and commercial relevance of project deliverables.
• Work directly with client stakeholders to understand their priorities, align on project objectives and communicate emerging findings and recommendations.
• Lead or contribute to client discussions, working sessions, presentations and senior stakeholder meetings.
• Develop clear, compelling and evidence-based presentations and reports for senior client audiences.
• Work effectively with geographically dispersed engagement teams, coordinating closely with colleagues in Singapore, GDS India and other ASEAN markets.
Strategy and transformation
You will work across a range of strategy and transformation engagements, which may include:
• Market entry and growth strategy
• Go-to-market strategy
• Revenue growth management
• Commercial transformation
• Digital and AI-led transformation
• Commercial due diligence
• Post-merger integration
• Divestment strategy and execution
• Cost and organization transformation
• Supply chain and procurement transformation
• Sales and operations planning
• Retail commercial and operational transformation
• Turnaround strategy and rapid value creation
Team leadership and capability development
• Lead, coach and develop teams working across GDS India, Singapore and the wider EY-Parthenon network.
• Provide clear direction, constructive feedback and day-to-day support to team members.
• Contribute to building a strong Consumer Products and Retail capability within EY-Parthenon GDS India.
• Support recruitment, onboarding, learning and broader capability-development initiatives.
• Help strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing between the Singapore and GDS India teams.
• Promote an inclusive, high-performing team environment focused on development, quality and client impact.
Business and practice development
• Support the development of ASEAN-focused proposals, credentials and other business-development materials.
• Contribute sector insights and subject-matter expertise to pursuit teams and client discussions.
• Help identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and support the development of new relationships.
• Contribute to the continued growth of the Strategy & Execution practice and its Consumer Products and Retail portfolio across ASEAN.
Skills And Attributes For Success
To succeed in this role, you should be able to:
• Lead complex strategy and transformation workstreams with limited supervision.
• Combine rigorous analysis with sound commercial judgment and practical recommendations.
• Communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently to senior internal and client stakeholders.
• Build trusted working relationships across different organizations, markets and cultures.
• Manage multiple priorities and maintain high standards in a fast-paced, project-based environment.
• Lead, motivate and develop diverse teams operating across locations.
• Collaborate effectively with Singapore-based and wider ASEAN engagement teams.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of the strategic, commercial and operational issues affecting Consumer Products and Retail businesses.
• Adapt your working approach to different client, cultural and market contexts.
To qualify for the role, you must have
• A bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. A master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
• At least six years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in a strategy consulting firm or a closely related consulting environment.
• Demonstrated experience in the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
• Experience leading substantial workstreams, project modules or client engagements.
• Strong problem-solving, analytical and financial analysis skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing and presenting materials for senior stakeholders.
• Experience managing and developing consulting teams.
• The ability to work effectively with colleagues and clients across locations, functions and cultures.
• A willingness and ability to travel internationally in line with client and engagement requirements.
Relevant Consumer Products And Retail Experience
Relevant experience should include one or more of the following areas:
• Corporate, portfolio, market entry or growth strategy
• Go-to-market strategy and commercial transformation
• Revenue growth management
• Digital and AI-led business transformation
• Cost reduction and operating-model transformation
• Supply chain and procurement transformation
• Sales and operations planning
• Retail commercial or operational transformation
• Commercial due diligence, post-merger integration or value creation
Ideally, you will also have
• Previous experience working with clients or consulting teams in Singapore, ASEAN or other international markets.
• Experience operating as part of a cross-border or globally integrated consulting team.
• Familiarity with the business environment, consumer trends and market dynamics of Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
• Experience supporting consulting proposals, business development and client pursuits.
• Experience building sector capabilities, coaching teams or contributing to recruitment and learning initiatives.
• Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with senior client stakeholders.
Regional exposure and ways of working
• The role requires close collaboration with colleagues and clients across ASEAN, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate regional engagement requirements.
• Periodic travel to Singapore and other ASEAN markets will be required, depending on client and engagement needs. This may include short-duration on-site assignments at different stages of an engagement.
• The successful candidate should be comfortable working in an integrated regional team, building relationships remotely and in person, and adapting to the requirements of cross-border client engagements.
• Strong performers may be considered for future international mobility opportunities, subject to business requirements, performance, immigration requirements and applicable firm policies.
What We Offer You
We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 25,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and help build a better working world.

title: Senior Consultant - Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
Your impact
Jacobs are seeking a Senior Consultant to join our Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory team to support high-impact transport and mobility advisory projects across the region. If you are passionate about rethinking mobility, advising clients, and solving complex urban transport challenges through delivery transformation and innovation, this role offers an exciting platform to accelerate your career.
As a Senior Consultant, you will support the delivery of multidisciplinary transport and mobility advisory services, working alongside project leaders and cross-functional teams. Your responsibilities will include
• Supporting the delivery of strategic transport and mobility advisory project, including urban mobility strategies, public transport policy, EV/AV deployment plans, freight and logistics advisory, and transport-related feasibility studies.
• Supporting project tasks, developing client-ready outputs, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Supporting the development of policy frameworks, business cases, and implementation plans for public and private sectors.
• Conducting research and analysis on emerging mobility trends and technologies (e.g. smart mobility, MaaS, low-carbon transport, ITS)
• Support the management of stakeholder consultation activities and preparing reports, presentations, and briefing materials for high-level government and private clients.
Here's what you'll need
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in transport planning, urban planning, economics, engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in transport or mobility consulting, with exposure to strategic advisory projects.
• Ability to work across a variety of transport topics, such as urban mobility, integrated transport planning, policy development or freight and logistics.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Proficiency in developing high-quality reports, presentations and strategic insights for clients.
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: KDN India_DAS_IT Due Diligence_Consultant
description:
About KPMG Delivery Network
The world of global advisory, audit and tax compliance services for large multi-nationals is rapidly changing and heavily dependent on technology. The KPMG Delivery Network (KDN) is a KPMG special purpose member firm offering a way for clients to leverage KPMG top talent and technology platforms through regional teams of specialists, enabling economies of scale and a new way of working that expands beyond local capability together with KDN, KPMG member firms can drive the sales and delivery of global solutions at a competitive price and in a repeatable and consistent manner.
As a member of KDN, you’ll be a part of the KPMG family working alongside some of our profession’s most skilled practitioners on rewarding programs and initiatives that are changing the way business operates, delivering value to our clients, and driving positive change in the communities we serve.
You’ll be enabling KDN accelerate new ways of working, using cutting-edge technology and working together with our member firms located in nearly 150 countries to help us achieve our ambition to be the most trusted and trustworthy professional services firm. And through your work, you’ll build a global network and unlock opportunities that you may not have thought possible with access to great support, vast resources, and an inclusive, supportive environment to help you reach your full potential.

Due Diligence

• Supporting key client workshops and meetings
• Supporting the Identification or review of client synergies for IT within a larger team

• Interacting with senior client stakeholders as well as internal stakeholders (KPMG Partners and Directors)
• When you are not working on a project, you will provide support to senior colleagues in a number of different aspects such as preparation of proposal materials and the development of team propositions and initiatives

Qualifications: MBA / Bachelor’s degree in a related field from an accredited college/university preferably with major in Technology.
Total Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in deal space (ITDD / IT Carve out / IT Integration) and not transformation projects.
Experience in implementing Information Technology processes, technologies, best practices, and frameworks, including:

• Network & Data Center Operations Management
• Software Development Life Cycle
• Service Management
• Security

• Infrastructure Optimization (e.g., consolidation, rationalization, cost savings)

• Experience in assisting with technology assessment/diligence

title: Senior Associate – Energy
description:
Job Title: Senior Associate – Energy
Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
Experience: 4-8 years of relevant post MBA experience 
About the Company
Alvarez & Marsal is a global professional services firm known for solving complex business challenges and delivering measurable results. Our teams work with organizations facing transformation, performance, restructuring, and growth priorities where practical execution matters as much as strategic direction. The firm brings together industry expertise, analytical rigor, and hands-on leadership to help clients improve performance and build lasting value. In India, our professionals collaborate across sectors and capabilities to address high-impact business problems for leading organizations. The Energy practice advises clients across the energy value chain, including oil and gas, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities. We value professionals who combine structured problem-solving with commercial judgment, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and take ownership for outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to work on challenging engagements, contribute to business development, and help shape solutions that influence critical decisions across the Energy sector.
About the Role
The Senior Associate will own high-impact workstreams for Energy-sector clients, combining deep sub-sector expertise with adaptable advisory skills across adjacent markets. The role will diagnose performance, strategy, restructuring, and operational challenges; convert analysis into clear recommendations; and support implementation that improves value, resilience, and execution. You will work across O&G upstream and downstream, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities, with the expectation of developing a differentiated point of view in at least one sub-sector. Success requires strong ownership of analyses, client-ready communication, team leadership, and the judgment to connect operational levers with financial and strategic impact. Based in Gurgaon and working onsite, you will collaborate closely with senior professionals and client teams on complex, time-sensitive engagements.
Key Responsibilities
• Own end-to-end workstreams across Energy consulting engagements, structuring ambiguous problems, defining analyses, and converting findings into decisions that improve client performance and enterprise value.
• Lead market, operational, financial, and strategic analyses using structured problem-solving, data, and business judgment to identify root causes and prioritize value-creation opportunities.
• Develop actionable recommendations for strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, and operational transformation, linking each initiative to measurable commercial or operating outcomes.
• Manage client interactions and senior stakeholder communication, presenting concise insights, challenging assumptions constructively, and building alignment around implementation priorities and ownership.
• Guide analysts and associates through problem definition, quality assurance, synthesis, and delivery, raising team capability while maintaining high standards for accuracy, pace, and clarity.
• Contribute to proposals, business development, and knowledge building by applying Energy-sector expertise to shape differentiated perspectives, compelling solutions, and repeatable intellectual capital.
• Adapt across adjacent Energy sub-sectors while maintaining deep expertise in at least one area, ensuring recommendations reflect sector economics, operating realities, and relevant value drivers.
Essential Skills & Technologies
• Deep expertise in at least one Energy sub-sector, such as O&G upstream or downstream, chemicals, mining, power, or utilities, with the ability to transfer insights across adjacent markets.
• Strong experience in consulting, advisory, or relevant industry roles spanning strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting, with ownership of complex workstreams.
• Advanced problem-solving, financial and operational analysis, executive communication, and stakeholder-management skills, supported by strong proficiency in standard analytical and presentation tools.
Additional Plus
• Experience delivering implementation programs or transformation initiatives where recommendations were translated into operating changes, performance gains, or measurable financial improvement.
• Exposure to multiple Energy sub-sectors, market situations, or geographies, enabling faster pattern recognition and more relevant recommendations for complex client contexts.
• Demonstrated contribution to proposals, client development, thought leadership, or internal capability building that strengthens the practice and creates new commercial opportunities.
What You'll Bring
• 4–8 years of total professional experience, including 3–6 years of post-MBA experience, gained in consulting, advisory, or relevant Energy industry roles.
• A strong academic foundation, including an MBA or related postgraduate qualification, with the commercial maturity to engage senior client stakeholders and influence important decisions.
• Demonstrated depth in at least one Energy sub-sector and the adaptability to work credibly across O&G, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities as client priorities require.
• A record of owning analytical and problem-solving workstreams across strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting engagements.
• The ability to move from data and diagnosis to practical recommendations, implementation priorities, and measurable business impact without losing attention to detail.
• Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the confidence to synthesize complex issues for executives and facilitate productive discussions with diverse stakeholders.
• A collaborative leadership style that develops junior team members, improves quality, and maintains momentum in fast-paced, high-expectation environments.
• Willingness to work onsite in Gurgaon and contribute actively to a team culture built around accountability, intellectual rigor, and hands-on delivery.
Why Join Us
• Work on consequential Energy-sector challenges where your analyses directly influence strategy, performance, restructuring, and investment decisions. You will see recommendations move from diagnosis into implementation and measurable client outcomes.
• Build differentiated expertise across a broad Energy landscape while developing depth in a chosen sub-sector. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, complex situations, and adjacent industries that accelerate commercial judgment.
• Join a performance-oriented team that values practical problem solving, clear communication, and ownership. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who expect high standards and support meaningful professional growth.
• Contribute beyond individual engagements through proposals, knowledge building, and practice development. Your perspectives can shape how the firm addresses evolving Energy-sector priorities and creates value for future clients.
What We Offer
• The opportunity to work on high-impact Energy engagements spanning strategy, performance improvement, restructuring, analytics, and operational transformation across leading industry segments.
• A platform for accelerated learning through direct client exposure, cross-sector problem solving, senior mentorship, and responsibility for workstreams with visible business impact.
• A collaborative, onsite Gurgaon environment with strong expectations for ownership, analytical rigor, practical execution, and contribution to the growth of the Energy advisory practice.

About the Company
Alvarez & Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance, create value and accelerate results. Founded in 1983, A&M is recognized for its entrepreneurial, action-oriented culture and hands-on approach to client problems. Its professionals work as independent thinkers and operators, combining practical execution with deep advisory expertise across industries and geographies. A&M’s Global Capability Center in India, established in 2023, partners with business units and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC to deliver end-to-end client work, not only back-office support. The rapidly growing center brings together consulting and industry professionals across Consumer & Retail, Healthcare, Software & Technology, Automotive & Industrials, Hospitality & Leisure, Energy & Natural Resources and Financial Services. Guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward and Inclusive Diversity, A&M focuses on leadership, action and results while creating measurable value for clients and stakeholders.
About the Role
As a Senior Associate in GDN Advisory, you will lead consulting workstreams that help organizations design, launch and optimize Global Business Services and Global Capability Center models. You will translate strategic priorities into practical operating models, business cases, transition plans and transformation roadmaps that improve service quality, efficiency and enterprise value. Working with A&M leaders, client executives and cross-functional teams, you will own analysis, solution design and client-ready deliverables across global markets and industries. The role combines structured problem solving with hands-on implementation, requiring confidence in senior stakeholder discussions and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You will also strengthen the practice through mentoring, proposal development and reusable GCC/GBS frameworks.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead GCC and GBS strategy and setup or expansion workstreams, converting client objectives into business cases, target operating models, governance structures and implementation priorities.
• Design TOMs, service delivery frameworks, SLAs and performance metrics that clarify accountability, improve service quality and enable measurable operating performance.
• Conduct location strategy, benchmarking, feasibility and cost-benefit analyses using market, workforce and financial evidence to support defensible investment decisions.
• Manage transition and implementation planning, including milestones, risks, dependencies, change actions and adoption levers that move recommendations into sustained execution.
• Build financial models, process maps and analytical views that identify efficiency, automation and service excellence opportunities across corporate functions.
• Partner with client executives, A&M leaders and cross-functional teams to shape solutions, facilitate discussions and deliver clear, high-quality outputs aligned to strategic priorities.
• Mentor Associates and Analysts while contributing to proposals, pitches, thought leadership and reusable GCC/GBS playbooks that expand team capability and business development impact.
Essential Skills & Technologies
• Demonstrated expertise in GBS, GCC or shared services setup, expansion or optimization, with strong understanding of operating model design, process transformation and transition execution.
• Proven ability to develop business cases, financial models, feasibility studies, investment cases and cost-benefit analyses that support senior client decisions.
• Strong proficiency in Excel modelling, PowerPoint and structured data analysis, with the ability to convert complex findings into concise, client-ready recommendations.
• Experience with TOM design, benchmarking, governance frameworks, SLAs, performance metrics and service delivery models across corporate functions or global operating environments.
• Familiarity with digital enablement, intelligent automation, analytics solutions or technology-led transformation, including how these levers improve efficiency and service outcomes.
• Excellent problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence interacting independently with senior client executives and leading workstream discussions.
• Strong project management, organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage deliverables, risks and timelines in fast-paced, global and multicultural teams.
Additional Plus
• Experience in a top-tier consulting firm, Big Four environment or a recognized advisory practice serving global transformation, shared services or operating model clients.
• Exposure to advanced degrees or professional qualifications such as CA, CFA or a master’s degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline.
• Experience supporting proposal development, thought leadership, internal knowledge building or the creation of GCC/GBS frameworks, tools and playbooks.
What You'll Bring
• You bring 4–7 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years after completing an MBA, with direct exposure to GBS, GCC or shared services strategy, transformation, setup, expansion or optimization.
• You bring the judgment to lead workstreams from structured analysis through client-ready recommendations, balancing strategic thinking with the practical detail required for transition and implementation.
• You bring strong commercial and analytical capability across business case development, financial modelling, benchmarking, location assessment, process mapping, operating model design and performance measurement.
• You bring clear communication and stakeholder leadership, enabling productive discussions with senior executives while mentoring junior colleagues and maintaining high standards for quality, organization and delivery.
• You bring an action-oriented consulting mindset: independent thinking, comfort with ambiguity, attention to detail and a commitment to creating tangible business value rather than producing recommendations that cannot be implemented.
Why Join Us
At A&M, you will work where advisory insight and operational execution meet. The GDN Advisory team helps organizations make high-stakes decisions about operating models, service delivery, talent ecosystems, transformation and technology-enabled performance. Your work will influence how global businesses structure capabilities, improve efficiency and create measurable value across markets. You will gain exposure to senior client stakeholders, complex cross-border programs and varied industries while working alongside experienced operators and consultants who value practical results. A&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high-performing professionals early responsibility and room to shape solutions, relationships and the growth of the practice. You will also benefit from mentorship, structured performance development, technical training, on-the-job learning and opportunities to build expertise through A&M University and internal knowledge platforms. The firm’s commitment to inclusive diversity, wellbeing, flexible support and professional mobility creates an environment where you can grow with purpose. This is an opportunity to build a differentiated career in transformation advisory while helping clients turn stagnation into growth.
What We Offer
• Early ownership of meaningful client work across GCC, GBS, operating model and transformation programs, with exposure to senior stakeholders and global industries.
• Structured performance development, technical training, on-the-job learning and mentorship that support continuous growth, broader consulting capability and career progression.
• An entrepreneurial, inclusive environment with opportunities for internal mobility, employee resource groups, wellness support, flexible work models and comprehensive benefits.

Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
Experience: 10-15 years
About the Company
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global professional services firm providing advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management, and interim leadership services to companies, investors, and government entities. Founded in 1983 as a restructuring boutique, A&M is known for practical, action-oriented solutions that help organizations tackle complex issues, improve operating performance, create value, and accelerate results across six continents. Its mission is to help organizations solve complex business issues and maximize stakeholder value. A&M’s culture is grounded in Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, with founding principles of Leadership, Action, and Results. In 2023, A&M established a Global Capability Center in India to support business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The GCC partners with case teams on end-to-end delivery and thought leadership, serving industries including Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center has grown to more than 1,000 professionals.
About the Role
As Manager, Transformation & Operations, you will own transformation workstreams and operational initiatives within A&M’s Corporate Shared Services team in the Gurgaon Global Capability Center. Reporting to the Director of Corporate Shared Services & Operations, you will convert strategic priorities into executable plans, reliable transitions, improved processes, and reusable operating capability. Your scope will span GCC/GBS transition planning, process design, documentation, business-case analysis, and operational excellence across functions such as HR, Marketing, and IT. This is a senior execution role for a hands-on operator with consulting rigor. You will work independently with functional teams, local operations, regional partners, and senior leaders while influencing without direct authority. The role is not a people-management position or a client-facing advisory role, although you will mentor junior colleagues and contribute to capability building.
Key Responsibilities
• Own two to three transformation or operational workstreams from planning through execution, using structured project plans, risk controls, quality reviews, and leadership reporting to deliver agreed outcomes.
• Execute GCC process transitions through detailed plans, handover controls, process documentation, training content, and change support that enable stable adoption by functional and operations teams.
• Design and maintain reusable playbooks, job aids, process libraries, and knowledge assets that codify best practices, improve consistency, and reduce dependency on individual process owners.
• Analyze costs, volumes, productivity, and efficiency metrics to identify improvement opportunities and build financial models, ROI calculations, and business cases for leadership decisions.
• Translate complex operational information into clear leadership updates, recommendations, and implementation priorities that support operating model governance and timely decisions.
• Partner with HR, Marketing, IT, regional teams, and GCC operations to resolve dependencies, influence without direct authority, and maintain momentum across interconnected initiatives.
• Mentor junior team members in consulting-style problem-solving, documentation standards, and execution discipline while supporting training plans for new associates.
• Track lessons learned and transition outcomes to strengthen future implementation methods, improve operational readiness, and build scalable capability across the growing GCC.
Essential Skills & Technologies
• 10–15 years of experience, including at least 10 years in GCC/GBS transformation, shared services, operations consulting, or project-delivery-focused corporate operations roles.
• Strong knowledge of GCC/GBS operating models, shared services best practices, transition planning, process improvement, process documentation, and execution-level change management.
• Demonstrated ownership of complex workstreams from planning through delivery, with the ability to manage risks, dependencies, deliverable quality, and multiple moving pieces independently.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, including cost, volume, efficiency, financial modelling, business-case development, and ROI analysis.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create clear documentation, training materials, leadership updates, and actionable recommendations.
• Ability to collaborate across functions and geographies, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and present findings effectively to functional leaders and operations teams.
• Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance, with prior consulting firm experience and knowledge of India GCC or multinational shared services environments preferred.
Additional Plus
• Experience delivering GCC/GBS transformation engagements, shared services implementations, or operating model transitions across multiple corporate functions.
• Prior experience in a Big Four firm, boutique consulting firm, consulting practice, or a comparable transformation-focused operations environment.
• Exposure to building reusable playbooks, process libraries, training programs, and capability-development mechanisms for growing operations teams.
What You'll Bring
• You bring 10–15 years of professional experience, including 10 or more years in GCC/GBS transformation, operations consulting, shared services, or project-delivery-focused corporate operations. Your experience shows sustained ownership of complex execution rather than strategy recommendations alone.
• You bring hands-on capability in workstream management, transition planning, process improvement, documentation, and change execution. You can turn broad priorities into detailed plans, control risks, maintain quality, and deliver outcomes with limited supervision.
• You bring strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to assess costs, volumes, efficiency, ROI, and operating trade-offs. You can build credible financial models and business cases that help leaders prioritize investments and improvements.
• You bring a Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance and communicate with clarity across senior leaders, functional teams, regional partners, and operations colleagues. You influence without authority, manage detail, mentor others, and remain effective in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
Why Join Us
At Alvarez & Marsal, you will join a global professional services firm where practical execution, independent thinking, and measurable results shape the work. This role offers the opportunity to help build and strengthen a rapidly growing Global Capability Center in India while working directly with local and global leadership. You will have visibility into strategic decision-making and direct ownership of transformation workstreams that influence how corporate functions operate and scale. The small central operations team provides meaningful responsibility, close collaboration, and room to expand your scope as the GCC and its capabilities grow. You will work across functions, geographies, and industries while building expertise in transitions, operating models, process improvement, and business performance. A&M supports professional growth through mentorship, formal training, A&M University, on-the-job learning, internal mobility, and performance development. The culture values integrity, quality, objectivity, inclusive diversity, and personal contribution, while encouraging people to bring an entrepreneurial, action-oriented approach to complex problems.
What We Offer
• Direct exposure to local and global leadership, meaningful ownership of transformation workstreams, and the opportunity to influence operating practices within a rapidly growing India Global Capability Center.
• A development environment combining formal training, A&M University, mentorship, on-the-job learning, performance development, and internal mobility for continued professional growth.
• Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, wellness resources, work-life balance support, employee resource groups, flexible work models, and opportunities to contribute to community programs.

title: Associate (AI) Solution Consultant
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
Role Description
As an Associate Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.
Launch Your Enterprise Software Career 
Your journey will start with onboarding & enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation & demo skills, discovery & objection handling as well as value selling.
Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.
During the program, you will be joining the Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.
This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.
Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:
• Discovery & AI Solutioning 
• Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
• Scoping business and technical requirements
• Effectively handling objections
• Developing industry domain knowledge
• Delivering impactful presentations and demos
• Understanding value selling and realization
• Managing customer accounts
What You'll Do:
• AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
• Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
• Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
• Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.
• Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries 
• Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.
• Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
• Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.
What You Need:
• Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
• Excellent communication skills in English
• Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.
• Excellent academic performance
• Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
• Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
• Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges.
• A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.
• Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.
• A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.
• Curiosity, self-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.
• Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain.
Bonus Points:
• Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills.
• Customer-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
• Hands-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
• Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering
• Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
• Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).
• Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.
• Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle
This a full time, unlimited position in our Bangalore office.
What Celonis can offer you:
• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
• Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
• Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
• Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
• Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
• Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
• Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
• Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
• Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
About Us:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
Your Privacy:
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: Oliver Wyman - iProcurement Specialist - Gurugram
description:
Oliver Wyman is now looking to recruit an iProcurement Specialist to join our India office and be part of our IMEA (India, Middle East, South Africa) team!
The role will be based out of Gurugram.
Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly organized and professional administrator to join the iProcurement team.
This is a hands-on iProcurement Specialist role based in Gurugram, India, working as the right hand to the IMEA iProcurement Regional Team Lead. You will run the day-to-day accounts payable and invoice processing engine for the region, and you will be the person stakeholders across India, the Middle East and Africa come to when they need an answer on a payment. Alongside the processing work, you will own the trackers and reporting that give the region visibility of payment status, aged items and spend, and you will support department budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
Key Responsibilities:
Invoice and accounts payable delivery
• Run the end-to-end invoice, requisition, purchase order and payment lifecycle for IMEA, making sure supplier invoices are coded, approved and paid accurately and on time.
• Deliver day-to-day accounts payable activity: invoice validation, purchase order and receipt matching, exception handling, credit notes, statement reconciliation and vendor query resolution.
• Support vendor onboarding, master data setup and documentation requirements, keeping records accurate, complete and compliant.
• Manage the department mailbox and shared queues, triaging invoice, requisition and payment queries and responding within agreed service levels. 
Stakeholder management and escalations
• Act as the first point of contact for stakeholders across the IMEA offices, resolving routine queries yourself and keeping requesters informed of status.
• Own escalations end to end influence without authority, hold evidence-based conversations with senior stakeholders on payment delays, non-compliant requests and policy requirements, and bring material risks to the Lead and OS Regional Manager.
• Partner with onshore and offshore Finance and accounts payable teams, vendors and MMC shared service teams to unblock issues across geographies and time zones.
• Act as the Lead's right hand, providing day-to-day support and covering agreed activities during absence, within clearly defined limits of authority.
Reporting, budgeting and analysis
• Maintain iProcurement trackers, dashboards and aged-item reports that give the region clear visibility of invoice status, payment risks, blocked items, vendor issues and forecast spend.
• Support department budgeting, forecasting and spend analysis: consolidate invoice and purchase order data, track actuals against budget, and flag variances, trends and exceptions.
• Prepare status updates, management information packs and briefings for the Regional Team Lead, Office Services Manager, Finance teams and senior stakeholders.
Process, compliance and continuity
• Monitor adherence to company finance and procurement policies, approval controls, documentation requirements and audit trials.
• Identify recurring issues, root causes and process gaps, and propose practical improvements that cut payment cycle times and rework.
• Support onboarding, training and knowledge transfer on iProcurement tools, procedures, payment requirements and best practices across OW IMEA.
• Maintain process documentation, escalation logs and handover notes so service holds up during absence, leave or changes in geographic remit.
• Handle sensitive stakeholders, vendor and financial information with confidentiality and discretion at all times.
Experience Required:
• At least 3 years of relevant experience in accounts payable, invoice processing, procurement operations or Finance shared services within a corporate environment.
• Practical experience managing the full accounts payable lifecycle, including invoice processing and coding, purchase order and receipt matching, approval workflows, payment processing and vendor reconciliations.
• Proven experience managing internal stakeholders, including senior stakeholders, and handling sensitive or challenging conversations when issues require escalation.
• Experience preparing and maintaining operational trackers, dashboards, aged-item reports, payment status reports and spend analysis.
• Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, spend tracking and variance analysis.
• Experience working with Finance ERP, procurement or payment systems.
Good to have:
• Experience working with onshore and offshore Finance and accounts payable teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
• Experience in management consultancy, professional services or financial services.
• Exposure to process improvement or automation initiatives in a finance operations environment.
• Team management experience
• Experience supporting India, Middle East and Africa locations.
Technical Skills:
• Experience with Oracle and/or iProcurement.
• Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including reconciliations, lookups, pivot tables, trackers, dashboards and spend analysis.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word and PowerPoint.
• Strong numerical and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and follow-through.
Skills & Attributes:
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the confidence to communicate payment and procurement updates clearly to stakeholders.
• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective relationships across different levels, cultures and geographies.
• Confidence and credibility when working with senior stakeholders, including the ability to explain and reinforce process and policy requirements constructively.
• Strong judgement and the ability to distinguish between issues that can be resolved independently and those requiring escalation.
• Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholder requirements simultaneously.
• Calm, pragmatic and solution-oriented when working under pressure.
• High levels of integrity and discretion when handling confidential financial, vendor and stakeholder information.
What this role offers:
• Direct exposure to the IMEA iProcurement Regional Team Lead and to senior stakeholders across six countries: you will be the name the region knows and calls.
• Genuine ownership of the region's payment reporting, budget tracking and spend analysis, not transaction processing alone.
• A clear development path towards Senior Administrator and, in time, regional team leadership.
• The opportunity to create, design and implement improvements where you see potential for growth and excellence.
• Opportunity to travel to Dubai and other office and event locations

You will serve as the operational owner for a portfolio of multiple regions/countries, leading managed-services vendor relationships, chairing regional payroll OpCos, managing complex and sensitive escalations, and driving transformation from RFP and design through cutover, parallel run, hypercare, and steady state. Serving as the senior operational owner and escalation point for complex or cross-border matters.

In doing so, you will partner closely with regional Payroll Governance, Employment Tax, and local stakeholders, champion process automation and standardization, lead and develop the GPT team, and represent regional operational priorities in global strategic forums.

Your work will strengthen payroll reliability, control, vendor accountability, standardization, and resilience across the multiple countries/regional footprint.

• 15+ years of payroll experience, with deep expertise in multi-country payroll operations across geographies
• Experience leading outsourced or managed-services payroll models, including vendor governance, SLA/KPI management, service reviews, cutovers, and parallel-run oversight
• Strong working knowledge of statutory, tax, and labour requirements across multiple jurisdictions, with sound judgment on when to engage specialist advisors
• Proven experience managing complex payroll issues, escalations, and competing stakeholder requirements across diverse jurisdictions
• Strong understanding of payroll controls, ICFR, audit, risk management, data integrity, and operational governance
• Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and motivating distributed or matrixed teams in a complex global environment
• Demonstrated credible leadership, analytics, problem-solving, project management, and communication skills
• Ability to offer new ideas, constructively challenge conventional wisdom, and work collaboratively across Finance, HR, Tax, Technology, local offices, and external partners
• Proven ability to analyze complex payroll issues, make sound recommendations, and lead analysis and reporting of key metrics
• Ability to work in-person and travel as needed (team schedules and office locations may vary)

• Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
• Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
Your Impact
You will play a critical leadership role in transforming and running multi-country payroll across the EEMA and APAC regions.
You will combine hands-on payroll transformation and implementation expertise with strong operational leadership, taking complex country payrolls from design and transition through go-live, stabilization, and high-quality steady-state delivery.
You will lead payroll transformation and managed services implementations across EEMA and APAC, partnering closely with regional Finance and HR leaders, Technology teams, and payroll providers. You will translate country requirements into robust solutions, challenge vendor designs, drive configuration and integration readiness, lead end-to-end testing and parallel payrolls, manage cutover and stabilization, and ensure that implementations meet demanding standards for accuracy, compliance, controls, employee experience, and business continuity.
Alongside transformation, you will be accountable for the ongoing health of payroll operations across your portfolio. You will govern payroll calendars and controls, manage provider performance against KPIs and SLAs, drive root-cause resolution of payroll issues, oversee statutory and regulatory readiness, strengthen SOPs and operating discipline, support internal and external audits, and ensure payroll queries and escalations are resolved with urgency and quality.
Your work requires someone who can move confidently between strategy and execution: understanding the details of payroll calculations and country requirements while also leading cross-functional programs, influencing senior stakeholders, and holding vendors and internal teams accountable for outcomes. You will help build a resilient payroll operating model that reduces manual dependency, strengthens tax and regulatory compliance, improves controls, and delivers accurate and timely pay every cycle.
You will be based in Gurugram or Chennai, as part of our Finance Global Operations - Payroll Team, with significant collaboration across EEMA and APAC time zones and travel as required for implementation and critical operational priorities.
Your Qualifications and Skills
• 10+ years of progressive payroll experience in a complex multinational or professional-services environment, with substantial hands-on responsibility for both multi-country payroll transformation/implementation and live payroll operations
• Demonstrated experience leading complex payroll implementations or transformations across multiple countries in EEMA and APAC markets; experience transitioning from in-house/SaaS payroll to managed services is highly desirable
• Deep practical knowledge of end-to-end payroll - from inputs and gross-to-net through controls, payments, accounting interfaces, statutory filings, year-end activities and post-payroll compliance - with the ability to identify risks and challenge solution designs
• Proven implementation of leadership across requirements and process design, fit-gap assessment, data migration, payroll configuration, integrations, test strategy, UAT, parallel payroll, cutover, go-live and stabilization. Experience recovering or de-risking challenging implementations is a strong advantage
• Strong multi-country payroll operations leadership, including payroll calendar governance, exception management, controls, reconciliations, issue resolution, service quality, business continuity, and employee/payroll query management
• Excellent vendor-management capability with experience governing major payroll providers or managed-services partners through clear SOWs, RACIs, KPIs, SLAs, governance forums, escalation mechanisms and performance improvement plans
• Strong understanding of payroll tax, statutory and regulatory compliance, with the judgment to engage country experts and tax advisers, translate regulatory changes into payroll actions, and ensure changes are tested and implemented on time
• Robust controls and risk mindset, with experience designing or operating payroll financial controls, supporting ICFR/SOX-style control environments, and leading remediation of internal or external audit findings
• Strong technology orientation and experience working across HRIS, payroll engines and finance systems. Working knowledge of SAP/SuccessFactors or comparable enterprise HR/payroll platforms and payroll integrations is preferred; familiarity with ServiceNow or similar case-management tools is advantageous

Why You Will Love this Job
To design, maintain, test and continuously improve the organization's Disaster Recovery and technical resilience capabilities by ensuring that critical systems, applications and infrastructure can be restored within agreed Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) enabling uninterrupted business operations during disruptive events.
KEY RESPONSIBILITES –
•  Disaster Recovery Planning & Documentation

•  Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of recovery procedures, dependencies, escalation paths, and ownership details.
•  Ensure DR documentation remains current and aligned with infrastructure and application changes.
Recovery Strategy & Governance
•  Define, document, and validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
•  Assess recovery capabilities against business requirements and recommend improvements where gaps exist.
•  Ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices related to Technical Disaster Recovery.
Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
•  Facilitate and conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) across business units.
•  Identify critical business services, application dependencies, infrastructure components, and recovery priorities.
•  Document recovery requirements, acceptable downtime, and operational impact assessments.
DR Testing & Validation

•  Validate recovery procedures and system recoverability against established RTO and RPO objectives.
•  Document test results, identify gaps, track remediation activities, and ensure closure of action items.
•  Produce management reports highlighting readiness status and improvement opportunities.
Infrastructure & Application Recovery Management
