The Team
At Alvarez & Marsal (A&M), the Senior Associate, Knowledge Management drives data discoverability through AI by managing complex metadata ecosystems across cloud-based platforms. Operating from our Delhi Global Capability Center (GCC), this professional ensures that high-value professional services knowledge assets remain flawlessly structured, compliant, and searchable across diverse environments during continuous platform migrations and enrichment exercises. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between structured library taxonomy and cloud data architecture, managing metadata lifecycles across collaborative, storage, and data warehouse layers
How You Will Contribute
• Vendor Assessment & Enterprise Implementation: Advise on and actively participate in vendor assessments, evaluations, and enterprise-wide implementations of taxonomy, ontology, and graph management systems
• Knowledge Graph Development: Design, build, and scale semantic knowledge graphs to map interconnected business concepts, industry verticals, and global advisory practices
• Taxonomy-to-Ontology Management: Transform flat data taxonomies into complex ontologies by defining, maintaining, and governing relationships, classes, and properties between distinct digital assets
• Multi-System Metadata Management: Design, map, and enforce metadata schemas across fragmented repository layers including SharePoint Online, Snowflake, Box, and others as identified in day-to-day operations
• Metadata Migrations: Plan, execute, and validate metadata migrations between and within cloud platforms, ensuring zero data loss, schema alignment, and continuous asset taxonomy
• System Interoperability: Coordinate cross-platform indexing to ensure assets stored across relational data warehouses (Snowflake), content repositories (Box), and collaboration hubs (Teams/SharePoint Online) remain structurally unified
• Data Cleansing & Reconciliation: Audit existing datasets to correct broken inheritance, fill missing metadata fields, and harmonize legacy taxonomies with global master data standards
Qualifications
• Experience Level: 3–5 years of direct metadata, semantic web, or data migration experience is required; 5+ years is highly preferred
• Education: Bachelor’s degree required. Completed or ongoing Master’s-level coursework in Library & Information Science (MLIS), Information Technology, Data Management, or a related technical discipline is highly preferred
• Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to effectively interface, interview, and collaborate with subject-matter experts across a wide variety of consulting specializations (e.g., corporate restructuring, transaction advisory, private equity)
• Semantic Capabilities: Solid understanding of semantic web concepts (such as RDF, OWL, SKOS, or graph structures) to manage relational data modeling. 
• System Expertise: Proven experience managing metadata structures within SharePoint Online (Managed Metadata Service), Snowflake (object tagging/data cataloging), and Box (custom metadata templates)
• Migration Tooling Collaboration: Familiarity collaborating with technical IT/infrastructure resources to manage mapping configurations via Sharegate or similar migration software (direct standalone administration of these engineering tools is not required)
• Coding/Scripting (Optional): Prior coding experience (such as SQL for Snowflake environments, PowerShell, or graph query languages like SPARQL/Cypher) is an asset but not required.
Your journey at A&M 
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Senior Research Analyst
description:
We're Hiring a Senior Research Analyst
About Us
SprintlyWorks is a fast-growing Nordic consulting firm known for high-impact work that helps clients solve complex business challenges. Our delivery teams work across industries, driving strategic transformations for leading companies.
About The Role
We are adding one senior researcher to our Market Research team. You will own consulting-grade research reports end to end: scoping the question, structuring the storyline, running the primary and secondary research, and delivering a client-ready report, typically within a two-week cycle.
This is a hands-on role. You won't have a large back office or a library of ready-made material behind you, so we are looking for someone who has built reports from a blank page and knows how the best strategy firms do it.
What You Will Do
• Scope and structure: Turn a client question into a research plan, issue tree and report storyline before the research starts.
• Secondary research: Build the fact base on markets, industries, competitors and trends from public sources, company filings, databases and industry reports/
• Primary research: Design interview guides and conduct interviews with client leadership, the client's in-house analysts and subject-matter experts, industry experts and customers. Synthesise what you hear into clear findings.
• Company deep dives: Review the client's internal documents, data and prior work to understand their starting point.
• Analysis and insight: Run market sizing, benchmarking, segmentation and value-chain analyses, and turn the numbers into clear "so-what" recommendations.
• Report production: Independently write and build full-length consulting reports, from executive summary to exhibits, ready for the client within a two-week cycle.
• Quality control: Source every figure, check the numbers and keep the storyline consistent from page one to the appendix.
• Work with the consulting team: Share interim findings with partners and project leads, take feedback and iterate quickly.
• Build the research engine: Help shape our research process, templates and reusable assets as the team grows
What We Are Looking For
Must have
• 5+ years in research roles, ideally in the research or knowledge teams of a strategy consulting firm (MBB, Tier-2 or boutique), or in a corporate strategy research function.
• A track record of independently authoring full-length consulting or industry reports. You will be asked to share one or two sanitised samples.
• Hands-on experience planning and conducting expert and stakeholder interviews.
• Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving (issue trees, pyramid principle, storylining).
• Excellent business writing in English.
• Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills.
• Comfortable working without large proprietary databases: you know how to find, triangulate and validate data yourself.
Nice to have
• MBA or relevant Master's degree.
• Experience with research databases and AI research tools.
• Depth in one or more industries, or familiarity with Nordic and European markets.
• Experience presenting findings directly to clients.
Why Join Us?
• Own your work: your reports go straight to clients and shape real strategic decisions.
• Work closely with partners and senior consultants, not behind layers of process.
• Help build the research function of a growing consulting firm.
• Competitive compensation, performance-based incentives and growth opportunities.
• Flexible work arrangements and a collaborative culture
Ready to Apply?
If you have built consulting reports from a blank page and want your work to carry real weight, we want to hear from you.
Apply Here!

The embedded Technical Support Unit (TSU) works alongside the Institution's teams, focusing on strengthening institutional capabilities, improving operational effectiveness, and embedding sustainable systems, policies, and practices.

The role requires strong leadership in agricultural finance, institutional transformation, programme management, and stakeholder engagement, along with the ability to translate strategic priorities into sustainable institutional outcomes.

SkyQuest is seeking an experienced senior programme leader to manage a 24-month technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria.
This is a leadership opportunity to drive institutional transformation, strengthen agricultural finance capabilities, oversee multidisciplinary specialist teams, and support the Institution in building sustainable mechanisms to mobilise and deploy capital for agricultural enterprises and smallholder-focused organisations.

• Lead programme governance, integrated planning, decision-making, escalation, risk and issue management, and formal phase-gate reviews.
• Manage a multidisciplinary team of specialist leads, establish clear accountabilities, allocate responsibilities, monitor delivery, and review all deliverables before submission.

title: Founder's Office - Operations Lead
description:
Founder's Office – Operations Lead
Location: Noida (on-site, 6 days a week) · Experience: 5–8 years · Reports to: CEO / Founders
The role:
SiteRecon is hiring an Operations Lead in the Founder's Office. You will work directly with the founders to find the problems that slow our business down, design practical solutions, and put them into practice on the ground, across a mapping operation of 120+ cartographers serving customers in the US and Canada.
This is not an advisory role. You will spot a problem in the data or on the floor, work out the fix, get Team Leads, Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Sales behind it, roll it out, and prove with numbers that it worked. Then you will move to the next one.
This role suits someone who thinks like a problem-solver, executes like an operator, and knows how to bring people along through change.
About SiteRecon
SiteRecon helps property-maintenance contractors in North America map properties and plan site visits in minutes, so they win more bids and run more profitable jobs. We were founded by IIT Delhi alumni with backgrounds in satellite imaging, e-commerce and edtech.
Learn more: https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us
What you'll do:
Find the problems that matter
• Dig into operations data, customer escalations and floor-level workflows to find what is hurting delivery, quality, cost or customer experience.
• Separate symptoms from root causes, size each problem by business impact, and agree priorities with the founders.
• Track the metrics that show where operations are slipping: productivity, TAT, SLA adherence, rework, backlog and capacity.
Design and implement solutions
• Turn each problem into a clear solution with an owner, a plan, a timeline and a success metric.
• Pilot changes with one team or shift, measure the results, and scale what works across the operation.
• Redesign SOPs, quality checks, workflows and team structures where needed, and make sure they hold on the floor after launch.
Lead technology and process change
• Work with Product and Engineering to define tool and workflow improvements for mapping and QA, and own their rollout to the floor.
• Identify manual, repetitive work that can be automated or simplified, and drive it through to implementation.
• Make sure operations can absorb significant growth in volume without the same growth in headcount or complexity.
Drive change management
• Win buy-in from Team Leads, QA Supervisors and cartographers for new ways of working, and handle resistance with clarity and patience.
• Plan communication, training and handholding for every change so adoption sticks across shifts.
• Align Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on changes that affect customers, delivery timelines or capacity.
Track and report improvements
• Build a simple tracker of every initiative: baseline, target, current result and owner.
• Set up daily, weekly and monthly dashboards that show the impact of changes on operational KPIs.
• Run regular reviews with the founders on what has improved, what has stalled, and what comes next.
Support the founders
• Take on high-priority operational projects directly from the founders, from capacity planning for a large new customer to setting up a new team or process.
• Act as the bridge between the founders' priorities and day-to-day execution on the floor.
You must have:
• 5–8 years of experience in operations excellence, process improvement, business transformation, founder's office or strategy-to-execution roles.
• Hands-on exposure to large, metrics-driven operations, such as GIS or mapping, data annotation, KPO, BPO or digital operations.
• A track record of finding a business problem, designing the solution and implementing it yourself, with measurable results you can show.
• Experience leading a technology or tool rollout with Product or Engineering teams and getting it adopted by the people who use it.
• Strong change-management and people skills. You can influence Team Leads and floor teams without direct authority.
• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You build your own analysis, trackers and dashboards.
• Clear, structured communication with founders, cross-functional teams and frontline staff.
Good to have
• Lean, Six Sigma or similar continuous-improvement training.
• Experience at a startup, SaaS or product company.

description:
ABOUT SKYQUEST

Learn more: https://www.skyquestt.com
THE OPPORTUNITY
SkyQuest is seeking an experienced agribuisness investment-readiness and transaction-advisory professional for a 24-month technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria.
The programme aims to strengthen the pipeline of bankable agribusinesses and improve access to finance for enterprises serving agricultural value chains and smallholder farmers.
Location: India and Nigeria, with in-country travel
Duration: 24 Months
Experience: 15+ Years
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Consultant – Agribusiness Investment & Transaction Advisory, you will help agribusinesses become investment-ready, develop a credible pipeline of bankable opportunities, and facilitate transactions with financial institutions and investors.
The role involves a live seed-enterprise demonstration and requires strong capabilities in financial modelling, due diligence, deal origination, transaction advisory, and investor engagement.
You will work closely with the Institution's teams and other technical specialists to establish sustainable investment-readiness processes and strengthen institutional capabilities.
THE PROGRAMME
SkyQuest is delivering a technical assistance programme to strengthen a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria.
The programme aims to improve the mobilisation and deployment of finance to agricultural enterprises and organisations serving smallholder farmers, particularly women and underserved producers.
The embedded Technical Support Unit (TSU) works alongside the Institution's teams, focusing on transferring sustainable capabilities and embedding validated systems, processes, and practices within the Institution.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Assess the Institution's investment pipeline, enterprise documentation, and existing investment-readiness practices.

• Work with agribusinesses to strengthen governance, operations, financial records, and overall financing readiness.
• Prepare investor-grade business plans, financial models, investment cases, and data rooms.
• Build a diversified pipeline of investment-ready agribusinesses across seed systems and other priority value chains.
• Originate investment opportunities and support investor engagement, due diligence, and transactions through to financial close.
• Lead or support the seed-enterprise demonstration, including enterprise assessment, integrated financial modelling, investment case development, financing strategy, and capital-provider mapping.
• Develop standard templates and toolkits, train the Institution's investment team, and facilitate the handover of processes to designated owners.
• Contribute performance indicators, programme results, and key learnings to programme reporting and the Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) framework.
QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
Education
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Agribusiness, or a related field.
• MBA or CFA qualification will be an advantage.
Professional Experience
• 15+ years of experience in investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity, or agribusiness investment.
• Proven ability to develop bankable business cases, financial models, and investor-ready data rooms, and manage due diligence processes.
• Demonstrated track record in deal origination and investor engagement, including taking transactions through to closing.
• Willingness and ability to work across India and Nigeria, including in-country travel.
DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE
• Strong understanding of seed systems and agricultural value chains.
• Experience with DFI, impact-investment, or blended-finance transactions in Sub-Saharan Africa.
• Previous experience working on development-partner-funded programmes.

description:

Randstad Enterprise Solutions — including Randstad Sourceright, Randstad Enterprise Group
and Randstad RiseSmart — provides solutions and expertise that help enterprise clients
position for growth, execute on strategy and improve business agility. Working across the
broad spectrum of Randstad Enterprise Solutions, the collective experience of the teams
encompasses all facets of the global talent spectrum, from the acquisition of talent to skilling
and coaching to outplacement solutions. Enabled by innovative technologies, key offerings
include HR and recruitment solutions, recruitment process outsourcing (RPO), managed
services programs (MSP), statement of work (SOW), outplacement, coaching and total talent
solutions.
Position Overview
The Director – Global Client Services & Operations Transformation Lead is a strategic leader
responsible for driving world-class delivery, operational transformation, and commercial scaling
across our global recruitment and scheduling operations.
Operating with an innovative, transformational mindset, this leader will oversee specialized
outsourced talent acquisition services—including end-to-end RPO/MSP delivery and high-volume
global scheduling operations—for premier enterprise tech clients. The primary mandate is to
institutionalize a Delivery Excellence & Continuous Innovation Framework, leveraging AI-driven
automation, data analytics, and continuous improvement methodologies to scale infrastructure,
optimize P&L profitability, and elevate client partnerships from operational delivery to strategic
management consulting.
Key Strategic Responsibilities
1. Strategic Client Leadership & Partnership
● Single Voice Governance: Serve as the primary liaison for global client stakeholders,
presenting a unified narrative across internal Global Business Services (GBS) and
regional delivery hubs.
● Consultative Value Creation: Move beyond standard status reporting by delivering
high-level analytical insights, labor market trends, and predictive talent analytics to
consult executive client leaders on talent strategy.
● Commercial Growth & Expansion: Partner with sales and commercial leads to drive
cross-selling, upsell initiatives, and expansion into new revenue streams by establishing
deep operational trust and exceeding SLAs.
2. Transformational Operational Excellence & Innovation
● Digital & AI Transformation: Spearhead operational modernization by integrating
automation, AI-driven scheduling tools, and modern tech workflows to enhance process
efficiency and service velocity.
● Workforce & Process Optimization: Standardize global SOPs and optimize workforce
management metrics—including utilization, adherence, capacity forecasting, occupancy,
and shrinkage—to eliminate delivery friction.
● Global Delivery Standardization: Institutionalize a "One Voice" service delivery model
across APAC, NAM, and global execution hubs to ensure uniform "Premier" service
experience regardless of geography.
● Enabling Function Accountability: Establish rigorous ROI tracking for operational
enabling functions (e.g., Training, Quality Assurance) to maximize individual productivity
and service consistency.
3. Financial & P&L Management
● P&L Responsibility: Oversee complete delivery budget and P&L across global accounts,
ensuring targets for profitability, margin expansion, and cost-of-delivery ratios are
achieved.
● Cost Efficiency & Contractual Rigor: Continuously evaluate SLA performance and
operational delivery costs to identify savings, streamline workflows, and mitigate
commercial risk.
4. People Leadership & Organizational Development
● Team Management: Lead, mentor, and inspire a large, multi-tiered global team (VPs,
Directors, Managers, and Operational Specialists) across matrixed structures.
● Capabilities & Upskilling: Build a continuous learning ecosystem utilizing Individual
Development Plans (IDPs), structured upskilling programs, and proactive succession
planning.
● Culture & Engagement: Cultivate a high-accountability, inclusive, and agile workplace
culture that encourages innovative problem-solving and high performance.
Core Competencies & Transformational Mindset
● Embracing Ambiguity & Change Leadership: Decisive leadership in uncertain, rapidly
changing environments; skilled at building structured frameworks within newly
consolidated or evolving entities.
● Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to translate complex operational datasets and
statistical modeling into actionable strategic risk mitigation and process improvements.
● Strategic Vision & Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen combining deep
understanding of financial P&Ls, client growth strategies, and enterprise talent
acquisition trends.
● Agility & Execution Courage: Ability to balance competing multi-stakeholder priorities
(global, regional, client) while maintaining rigorous operational control and driving
long-term strategic needle-movers.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
● Client Retention & NPS: Exceeding target client satisfaction scores and transforming
account status to strategic consulting partner.
● Operational Efficiency & ROI: Measurable reduction in cost-to-serve and cycle time
through automation, AI tools, and process optimization.
● Financial Growth: Portfolio profitability, revenue expansion, and strict adherence to
target P&L margins.
● SLA & Delivery Rigor: 98%+ global adherence to contractual SLAs, quality benchmarks,
and workforce management metrics.
● Talent Development: Employee retention, engagement metrics, and successful execution
of upskilling IDPs across the team.
Required Qualifications & Experience
● Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Operations, Human Resources,
or related field (Master’s Degree / MBA strongly preferred).
Experience:
● 20+ years of progressive corporate experience within RPO, MSP, BPO, or Global Talent
Acquisition Delivery environments.
● 10+ years in leadership roles managing large-scale global or multi-country operations.
● Proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar portfolios ($15M+) with direct P&L
accountability.
● Transformation Expertise: Demonstrated expertise leading process transformations,
implementing automation/AI technologies, and navigating complex matrix organizations.
● Travel: Willingness to travel locally and globally as required by business and client
demands.

description:

Crowe is looking to hire Valuation Services Senior Consultant - Financial Institutions to support valuation services needs.

Responsibilities:
•  Prepare financial models and detailed valuation analyses using various methodologies, including discounted cash flow, market multiples, and precedent transactions in a variety of industries for financial reporting, tax, and consulting valuations. 
•  FS focused team members: focus on financial instruments associated with financial institutions with a large emphasis on loans and deposits. 
•  Prepare comprehensive valuation reports and presentations that clearly communicate results, findings, and/or recommendations to clients.

•  FS focused team members: Analyze loan portfolios for portfolio risks and cash flow drivers. 
•  FS focused team members: Perform analysis and modeling relating to quantitative approaches for the estimation of loan portfolio credit loss, in accordance with the Current Expected Credit Loss ("CECL") standard (ASC 326).

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

title: Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer & Market Insights
description:
Role: Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer & Market Insights
About Us: Scrubsy is India’s #1 foam-based household cleaner - trusted by thousands of families for kitchen, bathroom, footwear, and all-purpose cleaning. We’re a fast growing D2C brand under BoldChem Science Pvt. Ltd., scaling rapidly across Amazon, our own website, and quick commerce platforms. We are a funded organization. We move fast, we care deeply about quality and we’re building the team that is passionate!
Brief: Scrubsy is building out a dedicated Consumer & Market Insights function to put the consumer at the centre of everything we launch, from formulations to fragrance to packaging to campaigns.
As Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer and Market Insights, you will be a core member of that team, working closely with the Senior Manager - Consumer and Market Insights. You will run the day-to-day research: Coordinating fieldwork with agency partners, Supporting Qualitative and Quantitative studies, Analysing Consumer and Market Data and turning them into clear, well-told and actionable findings.
Key Responsibilities
•  Support end-to-end research. Help plan and run Qualitative and Quantitative studies from Brief to Final Report.
•  Coordinate agency and field partners. Share briefs, discussion guides and questionnaires, track timelines and fieldwork quality, and keep projects moving on schedule.
•  Analyse and synthesise. Work through transcripts, verbatims, surveys and market data to pull out trends, themes, need states and clear takeaways.
•  Build the story. Prepare clean, insight-led presentations and toplines for the Leadership and cross-functional teams.
•  Track the consumer after launch. Monitor reviews, ratings, feedback and repeat signals from our D2C website and marketplaces, and flag what needs attention.
•  Do desk research. Scan Category, Competitor and Trend information to support study design and brand, R&D and marketing questions.
•  Keep the insights engine organised. Maintain trackers, a library of past studies and learnings, and research budget and timeline records.
•  Use modern tools. Use GenAI and analysis tools to speed up synthesis and reporting without losing rigour.
What We Are Looking For
Mandatory Requirement
•  4 to 7 years of experience in consumer insights or market research, in an agency, a brand or a D2C company.
•  Hands-on exposure to Qualitative research and Quantitative research.
•  Hands-on knowledge of Research Methodology: you know which approach fits which questions work and can design and run studies accordingly.
•  Hands-on data interpretation: You can work through surveys and tracking data and turn them into clear, actionable insights.
•  Experience with Consumer interactions and insights, from speaking with consumers to drawing out what matters.
•  Qualitative experience, particularly exploratory research (FGDs, IDIs or immersions), and the ability to summarise them into themes.
•  Good command of Excel and PowerPoint.
•  Graduate or postgraduate degree, ideally MBA / PGDM (Marketing) or equivalent.
Additional Requirement
•  Exposure to AI-driven insight tools, social listening platforms, or e-commerce/quick-commerce analytics
•  Exposure to FMCG (Home care, Personal care) industry.
•  Experience supporting NPD launches from exploratory research through to post-launch evaluation.
•  Brand health tracking experience.
•  Concept testing experience.
•  Pre and Post Campaign evaluation experience.
•  Familiarity with syndicated data and brand tracking platforms.
Who You Are
•  Proactive - You don't wait to be told a metric or perception is slipping; before marketing asks "what happened," and you come with the why, not just the what
•  Ownership Driven - You own the research question end-to-end — from writing the brief to fieldwork to the final recommendation that actually gets used
•  Data Conscious - You validate every insight or "consumer said" claim across segments, methodologies, and sample sizes before it goes to leadership
•  Organized - you run a busy, always-on calendar of trackers, ad-hoc studies, and agency deliverables across multiple categories without a wave, deadline, or stakeholder slipping through the cracks.
•  Progressive Learner - You understand that Learning is a continuous process and are willing to learn new methodologies and ways of working, while being unafraid to think outside the box and putting across your PoV.
